jobs.title: Case Manager, PPO - 26-126
jobs.description:
**We’re delighted you’re considering joining us!**

At Hill Physicians Medical Group, we’re shaping the healthcare of the future: actively managed care that prevents disease, supports those with chronic conditions and anticipates the needs of our members.

**Join Our Team!**

Hill Physicians has much to offer prospective employees. We’re regularly recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in the Bay Area” and have been recognized as one of the “Healthiest Places to Work in the Bay Area.” When you join our team, you’re making a great choice for your professional career and your personal satisfaction.

**DE&I Statement:**

At PriMed, your uniqueness is valued, celebrated, encouraged, supported, and embraced. Whatever your relationship with Hill Physicians, we welcome ALL that you are.

We value and respect your race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, disabilities, experiences, perspectives, and other attributes. Our celebration of diversity and foundation of inclusion allows us to leverage our differences and capitalize on our similarities to better serve our communities. We do it because it's right!

**Job Description:**

Responsible for carrying out case management activities for PPO members identified through data or by Health Plan and referred to HPMG. Case management is a collaborative process that assesses, plans, implements, coordinates, monitors, and evaluates options and services required to meet the client’s health and human service needs. It is characterized by advocacy, communication and resource management and promotes quality and cost-effective interventions and outcomes. Case management activities are based on nationally recognized case management standards and concepts and principles. All contacts are telephonic.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Health Plans care and disease management programs to maximize the at-risk population member’s quality and manage their costs.
* Assess members’ physical and psychosocial needs/barriers and develop a care plan.
* Support and encourage the use of participating Health Plan providers.
* Develop and implement the interventions needed to resolve barriers and coordinate care, allowing members to accomplish their goals with physician guidance and supervision.
* Document in Epic; assessments, care plans, interventions, and all other activity related to coordinating the care of case-managed members.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Maintain client privacy, safety, confidentiality, and advocacy while adhering to ethical, legal, regulatory and accreditation standards.
* Maintain department procedure/policy standards with regard to turnaround time, etc.
* Support the interdisciplinary team approach to ensure effective resource utilization, as well as quality and cost-effective outcomes.
* Coordinate internal and external resources for the individual member.
* Maintain and update a community resource database.
* Document all case management activities in the HPMG case management online system.
* Issue letters of explanation in accordance with department policy.
* Attend and participate in in-service programs and conferences that support practice of case management.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum three years clinical nursing experience in an area such as medical/surgical, critical care, home health or skilled nursing, and;
* Two years of experience in case management, behavioral health, utilization management, discharge planning, and or quality improvement in a managed care setting.
* Experience with managed care delivery including IPA networks and Medicare. PPO experience preferred.
* Optimum organizational skills with ability to meet both expected and unexpected time frames.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with a variety of customers including members, providers, office staff, health plans, internal department, community resources, and peers.
* Ability to work independently with self-initiative and discipline.
* Knowledge of ICD-9 and or CPT coding.
* Working knowledge of personal computers.

**Required Education**

* A.S. degree
* Unrestricted California Registered Nurse licensure; certification in case management preferred.

**Additional Information**

Salary: $100,100 - $123,000 Annual

**Hill Physicians is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Human Resources Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

**Why Rosendin?**
-----------------

**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**
-----------------------------------

If you're looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. Since our founding over 100+ years ago, Rosendin has been driven to positively impact the communities where we live and work. We are an organization built on integrity, and we have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. As one of the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. When our people succeed and fuel our success, we reward them. We'd love to have you as a shareholder!

  

**YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:**
--------------------------

The HR Operations Manager leads the HR Ops team as part of a shared services model responsible for the accurate, timely execution of core HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, leave administration, and day-to-day HR Ops case management. This role manages through the HR Ops Leads rather than individual contributors directly, and carries real ownership over how the function is shaped: sizing and structuring the pods to match the volume and complexity of incoming work, scaling capacity up or down as business needs shift, and elevating process improvements so fixes become standard practice rather than one-off patches. The HR Operations Manager also shapes the policies that govern how the shared-services model operates, and serves as the escalation point for employee relations matters and process issues that fall outside established playbooks. This role partners closely with the Sr. Manager, HR Operations, and with peer leaders across HR Ops (Program Management, HR Technology, People Analytics) to keep pod-level execution aligned with broader HR Ops strategy.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
-------------------

* Org Design & Capacity Planning
  + Assess the volume and complexity of work flowing into HR Ops and forecast staffing needs accordingly
  + Design and adjust pod structure and staffing levels to match demand, scaling capacity up or down as business needs change
  + Partner with the Sr. Manager, HR Operations on headcount planning and resourcing recommendations, backed by data on workload and capacity
  + Model capacity scenarios to inform hiring, cross-training, and workload redistribution decisions across pods
* Team Leadership & People Management
  + Manage the HR Ops Leads for Pod A and Pod B, including performance reviews, coaching, pay decisions, and career development
  + Set pod-level goals and deliverables; assess performance against those goals and evaluate readiness for career progression based on business needs
  + Provide indirect oversight and escalation support for HR Ops Specialists and Admins through the Leads, ensuring consistent standards across both pods
  + Balance workload and staffing across pods to maintain service levels during peak periods or coverage gaps
* Process Execution & Service Delivery
  + Ensure HR Ops pods execute core processes - onboarding, leave administration, employee records, and case management - accurately and within established timeframes
  + Monitor service-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, case quality) across both pods and address gaps proactively
* Process Improvement & Elevation
  + Identify process improvement opportunities surfaced by pod-level work and elevate them for broader adoption across HR Ops, rather than letting fixes stay local to one pod
  + Partner with Program Management and HR Technology to standardize improvements once they've proven out at the pod level
  + Maintain a systematic way to capture and prioritize process issues, so improvement work is deliberate rather than ad hoc
* Employee Relations & Escalation
  + Serve as the escalation point for employee relations matters and complex situations that fall outside pod-level resolution
  + Provide guidance and support to HR Ops Leads, Specialists, and people managers across the organization on HR-related issues
  + De-escalate difficult or emotional situations with fairness, professionalism, and sensitivity - balancing the employee's perspective with confident adherence to policy, regulation, and precedent
* Policy Ownership, Compliance & Risk
  + Own and evolve the HR policies that govern the shared-services model, ensuring consistent, scalable application across the organization as it grows
  + Build and maintain the company handbook
  + Represent operational feasibility when new HR policies are proposed elsewhere in the organization, ensuring policy decisions account for what pods can realistically deliver at scale
  + Ensure HR Ops processes comply with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations
  + Partner with Legal and Compliance on policy updates and process changes
  + Oversee the accuracy and integrity of HRIS data across both pods
* Reporting & Cross-Functional Partnership
  + Monitor and analyze HR Ops metrics, providing regular reports to the Sr. Manager, HR Operations on trends, risks, and capacity signalsPartner with the Sr. Manager, HR Operations, and peer leaders across Program Management, HR Technology, and People Analytics to align pod execution with broader HR Ops initiatives

  

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:**
--------------------------------------

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**  

* Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.
* Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill
* Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

  
**Education**

High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

12

**Time Type**

Part time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$23.50 - $37.50

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  
This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

  
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 01/06/2027

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.  
  
  

### **Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
* Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
* Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
* Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
* Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
* Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
* Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
* Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
* Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
* Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
* Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
* Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience supporting B2B marketing efforts or high-volume audience segments at global scale
* Experience leading the transition of a workflow from manual execution to automated or agentic execution
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
* SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
* Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

San Francisco

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Hybrid

**Department**
--------------

G&AOperations & People

Overview

**About Liquid AI**

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across every kind of hardware, from data center accelerators to on-device chips, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.

**The Opportunity**

Our People team shapes how Liquid AI grows and how we look after our people, across the US and around the world.

We’re hiring a People Operations Manager to own our HR data and the operations that run on it, so every moment in someone’s time at Liquid AI is handled properly: their offer, their first day, a move to a new country, a visa, a pay review, their last day.

Behind every record is a person. Getting the details right is one of the most direct ways we look after our team, and you’ll make sure they’re right without needing to be chased.

You’ll report to our Head of People Operations and work closely with the engineers on our People team, testing and shaping the internal operating system they’re building. This is a hands-on operator role, not an HR business partner role.

This role will be based in our SF office, typically 4 days a week.

**What We’re Looking For**

We need someone who is:

* **Detail-oriented:** You notice when something doesn’t match, see how one change affects everything downstream, and fix it.
* **A team player:** You pitch in wherever the team needs you, and no task is too small.
* **Self-directed:** You get things done without much supervision, and you know when to escalate.
* **Someone who ships:** You work at pace, get through a high volume of work, and don’t let quality slip while you do it.
* **Someone who cares about people:** You see this work as part of how we look after our team, and you handle sensitive information with care.

**The Work**

* **Own our HR data:** keep HR, payroll and headcount records accurate and matching across systems, run regular checks, fix errors fast, and flag where they’re coming from
* **Handle onboarding and offboarding admin:** take care of the paperwork and system setup for every new starter and leaver, so their records are complete and correct from day one to their last
* **Manage employee changes:** process contractor conversions, moves between states or countries, contract amendments, salary changes, leaves and visa updates, so each one is touched once and done right in every system; for visas, work with our outside immigration counsel on documents and deadlines
* **Run benefits operations:** lead open enrollment, keep plan documents current and on hand, and work with our broker on renewals and compliance
* **Manage our people vendors:** be the day-to-day admin and escalation point for our HRIS, payroll, benefits and global EOR providers, and push open issues until they’re closed
* **Run comp analysis and offer letters:** benchmark roles against market data, model the full cost of offers and changes across countries, and prepare accurate offer letters consistent with approved terms
* **Help run cross-functional projects:** work with teams across the company on People projects, including our coworking weeks, which bring the team together several times a year
* **Test and shape our internal operating system:** be our main beta tester, running new features against real cases and working with the engineers until it’s right

**Experience & Capabilities**

What you’ll need:

* Experience in People Operations, HR operations or payroll, including time at an early-stage startup or on a small team where you covered a bit of everything
* Hands-on admin experience with a modern HRIS (Rippling, Workday, Deel or similar), owning the data and processing onboarding, offboarding and employee changes in it
* Experience with employees across multiple US states and countries
* Working knowledge of US benefits and compliance (open enrollment, ERISA, COBRA)
* Strong spreadsheet and analysis skills: comp benchmarks, cost models, headcount reporting, and the habit of checking your own numbers

Helpful, not required:

* A background in finance, accounting or payroll
* Experience with US immigration processes (H-1B, O-1, green cards) alongside outside counsel
* Experience with comp benchmarking tools such as Pave or Carta

**What Success Looks Like (Year One)**

* HR, payroll and headcount records match across every system, with regular checks that catch errors before anyone else does
* Every employee change, benefits cycle and vendor issue is closed and tracked in one place
* Our internal operating system has a tight feedback loop with the operations work you do every day

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation & Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.
* **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.
* **Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.
* **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Assistant Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**We're not a typical clinic.**

Cerebral Health exists for patients with complex neurological injuries — post-concussion athletes who aren't recovering on the expected timeline, accident survivors dealing with persistent vestibular dysfunction, people who've been told their imaging is normal but whose lives clearly aren't. We take those cases seriously. And we get results.

We're one of the few clinics in the region offering advanced neurological rehabilitation technology that most practices simply don't have. Our patients find us after exhausting other options. What we offer them is precision diagnostics, evidence-based neurological rehabilitation care, and a team that genuinely knows what they're doing.

Our team of 20 is collaborative, fast-paced, supportive, and united around a single mission — and that mission has real stakes. Our patients are coming to us to get their lives back. That means results aren't optional here. Every person on this team holds themselves to that standard: leading with a learner's heart, bringing compassion to every interaction, going above and beyond for the people in their care, and finding strength in working together. We don't just care about our patients. We are accountable to them.

That's the environment you'd be stepping into.

**The role**

This is a hands-on clinic leadership role built for someone who wants to grow. You'll own the front desk and the daily operation of the clinic. From there, you'll take on the scorecard, then the team.

You'll report directly to our Director of People & Operations and be mentored by her week to week. We operate on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System): structured meetings, clear accountability, and real ownership of your results.

This is not a passive coordinator role. If you like being in the work, being the person who makes the work better, and want a seat that grows as fast as you do, this is it.

Your growth path

Each stage opens once you fully own the one before it and its KPIs, not just time in the seat.

What you'll be doing

**Front Operations**

* Lead the front desk and HBOT/PEMF teams day to day, including remote team members, and be the person they turn to

* Guide patients through the full care journey, from consultation scheduling through discharge

* Manage the Personal Injury workflow: liens, attorney communication, PI payments and checks, subpoenas, and case follow-up

* Process payments accurately across standard fees, CareCredit, PI checks, and refunds; generate superbills

* Keep patient records accurate and HIPAA-compliant; audit trackers and follow-up logs so no patient or lead falls through the cracks

* Resolve patient complaints and keep the patient experience at the standard our patients deserve

* Step in on calls, check-in, and HBOT/PEMF coverage when the clinic needs it

**Clinic operations**

* Run patient flow, scheduling, room readiness, and daily clinic logistics

* Manage vendors, supplies, supplement inventory, and facility needs

* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, OSHA, and safety standards

* Build, update, and enforce SOPs across all clinic functions, and train staff to them

* Own clinic systems including Jane, Google Workspace, and Gusto

* Track KPIs, maintain the clinic scorecard, and bring issues and solutions to weekly L10 meetings and quarterly planning

jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
The Discovery team sits at the intersection of product analytics and operations within Uber Eats, owning one of the highest-leverage surfaces on the platform, how millions of eaters discover restaurants, grocery, and retail stores every day. This is not a traditional operations role. You will spend the majority of your time deep in data, writing complex SQL, building analytical frameworks, and running experiments that directly shape search ranking and cross-LOB placement across Uber Eats.  
  
You will be the analytical backbone for Search, partnering hands-on with Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and peer Ops teams to translate massive datasets into actionable insights that influence ranking algorithms, drive experimentation roadmaps, and optimize how traffic is allocated across restaurants, grocery, and retail. If you thrive on navigating ambiguity with data rather than playbooks, and want to see your analysis directly move product decisions at scale, this is the role.  
  
**What You'll Do**  

* Own search analytics end-to-end: Write complex SQL queries against large-scale datasets to analyze search ranking performance, cross-LOB store and item placement, and conversion patterns across categories
* Build analytical products: Create and maintain dashboards, automated reporting, and monitoring tools that give Product, Ops, and Leadership real-time visibility into search health, ranking quality, and surface-level KPIs (conversion, GMV, engagement)
* Translate data into product influence: Synthesize operational and behavioral insights into clear recommendations that shape the search product roadmap, identifying ranking biases, surfacing gaps in cross-LOB allocation, and quantifying the impact of proposed changes
* Collaborate cross-functionally: Work across Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and regional Ops teams to ensure search strategy is grounded in data and aligned across stakeholders. Serve as the connective tissue between operational reality and product development
* Manage programs and projects: Independently drive multiple workstreams from competitive search intelligence to new surface launches tracking details, managing timelines, and delivering in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift
* Scale shared surface governance: Contribute to Share of Voice frameworks and traffic allocation governance across Restaurants, Grocery, and Retail on shared discovery surfaces

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics) or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or analytically-heavy operations roles
* Advanced SQL proficiency, write complex, production-quality queries against large-scale data warehouses (Hive/Presto or equivalent)
* Hands-on experience with Python or R for data manipulation, analysis, and automation
* Experience building dashboards and automated reporting that serve cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated track record of using data to influence product or business decisions in a cross-functional environment

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 5+ years of professional work experience in a related field, such as consulting, investment banking, strategy, operations, or analytics
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets or SQL proficiency
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
* Experience problem-solving and proposing unique solutions to complex issues
* Strong experience building and executing complex processes
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including experience presenting data & insights to a sophisticated audience
* Experience with quantitative data analysis to provide deep measurable insights
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills - building deep, trust-based relationships with teams and cross-functional partners
* Strong business judgment and critical thinking skills with the ability to use data to develop strategies and make decisions quickly

In this role, you will bridge the gap between client leadership, vendor partners, and cross-functional teams to turn traditional reception desks and mailrooms into frictionless, user-centric, high-touch service hubs.

You bring a blend of hospitality mindset, analytical rigor, and process engineering to build scalable programs, set operational benchmarks, and deliver a welcoming first impression for every client and guest.

Program Oversight & Service Delivery

* **Program Ownership:** Define and execute the long-term vision, roadmap, and strategic goals for the Reception and Mail programs.
* **User Journey & Experience Design:** Map and continuously optimize the end-to-end guest and employee journey. Identify touchpoints to remove friction, enhance hospitality, and maintain a seamless experience.
* **Standard Operating Procedures:** Proactively develop, implement, and maintain unified SOPs for both the Reception (visitor management, security log audits, incident response) and Mail Room (routing, bulk mail processing, package room workflows) programs.
* **Process Improvement:** Shape and deploy a process-management mentality focused on driving efficiencies, cost-conscious resource optimization, and leveraging JLL best practices.
* **Training & Hospitality Standards:** Design, own, and manage the onboarding, hospitality service standards, and continuous development protocols for site teams executing Mail and Reception duties to ensure high-quality, hospitality-driven service delivery.
* **Quality Control & Compliance:** Verify the accuracy of visitor tracking, security badge protocols, and chain-of-custody mail logs. Conduct regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with health, safety, and site security requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Integration:** Partner with the Facilities team to align workplace services with broader site goals.

Client Relationships & Performance Management

* **Client Engagement:** Proactively manage relationships with the Client’s Program SMEs and senior executives, translating their business objectives into actionable program strategies.
* **KPI & SLA Compliance:** Monitor program performance using data-driven insights. Deeply understand and report on contract KPIs, analyze metric variances, and implement mitigation strategies to meet or exceed targets.
* **Reporting & Data Intelligence:** Develop, implement, and present a suite of management reports and metrics to the Client and account leadership, visualizing data to derive actionable intelligence.
* **Partner & Vendor Governance:** Collaborate closely with integrated facilities partners and external service providers to ensure vendor delivery meets client’s safety, security, and hospitality expectations.
* **Budget Support:** Support program budgeting, track capital and operational expenditures, and identify opportunities for scalable cost efficiency.

Qualifications

* **Experience:** Minimum 4- 6 years of leadership in high-touch, hospitality environments. Demonstrated expertise with VIP service standards and building white-glove service culture from the ground up.
* **Process Management:** Demonstrated success in process engineering or workflow optimization.
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong ability to extrapolate and visualize data to identify potential operational gaps and proactively formulate contingency plans.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Exceptional leadership and team-building skills with a track record of driving results through cross-functional teams without direct line-management authority.
* **Communication & Credibility:** High emotional intelligence with excellent presentation and negotiation skills; must be highly credible when interface-sharing with executive-level client personnel.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Familiarity with modern corporate site services, including advanced visitor management software, enterprise mail/package tracking platforms, and postal regulations.
* **Flexibility:** A future-forward mindset capable of balancing strict operational rigor with the speed, responsiveness, and flexibility required in a fast-paced corporate environment.
* **Education (Preferred):** Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management is preferred.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Workplace Relocations & Events
jobs.description:
* **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area client sites
* **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor (1099), project-based
* **Capacity:** Approximately two project deliveries per month, with overlapping discovery, planning and closeout activities
* **Schedule:** Flexible planning hours, plus nights and weekends on move and event dates
* **Reports to:** Founder
* **Compensation:** Based on experience

**About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Project Manager to lead client projects from discovery through planning, on-site delivery and closeout. You will serve as the primary day-to-day client contact, manage project schedules and budgets, and coordinate the vendors and support teams responsible for delivery. The anticipated workload is approximately two project deliveries per month, with assignments and staffing based on project size, complexity and on-site requirements.

This role combines remote planning and coordination with in-person walkthroughs, site supervision and post-move support. Success means independently moving projects forward, maintaining clear communication and providing reliable coverage during critical activities while minimizing disruption to employees and business operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesDiscovery and Scoping**

* Lead discovery meetings and site walkthroughs to define scope, budget, schedule, inventory and site requirements.
* Source vendors, evaluate estimates and develop proposals and scopes of work, including assumptions and exclusions.

**Planning and Coordination**

* Maintain project schedules, move plans, inventories and labeling instructions.
* Coordinate clients, building teams and vendors across IT disconnect/reconnect, furniture, storage and workspace setup.
* Confirm site access, dock and elevator reservations, insurance and building requirements.
* Prepare employee move instructions and track decisions, action items and staffing needs.

**On-Site Delivery**

* Verify site readiness and direct movers, vendors and support staff during load-out, delivery, installation and event resets.
* Manage vendor sequencing, resolve issues and escalate changes affecting scope, cost or schedule.
* Inspect completed work and track post-move issues through resolution.

**Budget Management and Closeout**

* Track budgets, vendor costs, invoices and change orders; obtain approval before committing to additional work.
* Confirm client acceptance, reconcile final costs and prepare billing records.
* Archive project documentation and capture lessons learned.

**About You**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Workplace Relocations & Events
jobs.description:
**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area client sites

**Employment type:** Independent Contractor (1099), project-based

**Schedule:** Flexible planning hours, plus nights and weekends on move and event dates

**Reports to:** Founder

**Compensation:** Based on experience

**About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator who enjoys hands-on work, changing environments and seeing a plan come together.

You will support all projects across Shift’s portfolio, attending scheduled moves and events to help supervise vendors, check placement and resolve setup issues. While Project Managers lead their assigned projects, you will provide consistent on-site support across the team.

This is an evolving role with room to grow into project management. You will learn how to plan moves, coordinate vendors and support clients while taking increasing responsibility for project workstreams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Move Preparation**

* Support site walkthroughs and prepare inventories, photographs and project checklists.
* Print and organize box labels, desk tags, signage and placement instructions.
* Hang signage and confirm rooms, desks and destination areas are clearly marked.
* Review move plans, floor plans and assignments with the Project Manager before each move.

**Site Supervision and Move Support**

* Attend scheduled moves and events across Shift’s project portfolio.
* Provide on-site direction to movers and support vendors within the approved move plan.
* Check that boxes, furniture and equipment arrive in the correct locations.
* Track progress, flag missing or misplaced items and escalate to the Project Manager.
* Support furniture load-out, staging and workplace resets for events.
* Keep checklists and issue logs current, with photographs where needed.

**Technology and Workplace Readiness**

* Coordinate with IT teams to confirm equipment placement and completion of disconnect/reconnect work.
* Use client-approved checklists to check workstation setup and basic technology readiness; refer technical issues to IT.
* Check shared spaces, supplies and signage before employees arrive.
* Support unpacking, organization and post-move requests, tracking outstanding items through resolution.

**About You**

You notice when a label is wrong, a box is missing or a workstation is not ready. You follow instructions carefully, ask questions when something is unclear and look for the next task without waiting to be prompted.

You enjoy being on your feet and working at different sites rather than spending every day at the same desk. You are dependable, comfortable speaking with vendors and interested in learning how to manage projects.

**Requirements and Skills**

* Experience in workplace services, events, hospitality, facilities, logistics or another role requiring organization and customer service.

Prior move experience is helpful but not required. We welcome candidates who bring dependable follow-through and a willingness to learn.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in data centers.
* Experience in cyber security, artificial intelligence, analysis, and process engineering.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in Task Flow.
* Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or similar methods to streamline workflows, cut cycle times and improve how well vulnerability remediation programs scale.
* Familiarity with data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical and cooling controls, and how cybersecurity risk turns into operational and uptime risk.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
* Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
* Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.
* Keep milestones, dependencies, blockers and SLO performance visible. Write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.

**SYNAPSE SCHOOL POSITION OVERVIEW: After Care Coordinator**

The Synapse School in Menlo Park, CA, an innovative TK-8 independent school located in the heart of Silicon Valley, dedicated to rethinking and reimagining education, seeks an **AFTERCARE COORDINATOR** for an immediate opening.

Synapse educates a community of Change Makers by combining Social-Emotional Learning (SEL), leading-edge academics, and the practice of innovation. We have an unwavering belief in the capacity of children, and our teachers work alongside our students to unlock their powers of curiosity, discovery, and creativity. Synapse’s program provides a deep and unique range of integrated academic, social, and creative experiences to help children use their hearts and hands to unleash their passion for learning. Synapse draws students from around the San Francisco Bay Area.

Synapse is a place for people who like being in schools, who bring energy, perspective, and a sense that what we do for our students, families and colleagues matters. People who are optimistic about young people and about the world, who collaborate and communicate generously, and who approach challenges with creativity rather than cynicism, thrive at Synapse.

As a lab school, we are actively integrating AI and emerging technologies into teaching, learning, and operating. Strong candidates will be open to using AI as a tool for planning, feedback, differentiation, and innovation. Comfort with experimentation and continuous learning is essential; perfection is not.

Equally important, we’re looking for educators who model strong emotional intelligence and embody our Change Maker Outcomes: communication, perspective, risk-taking, follow through, creativity, advocacy, inquiry, feedback, and iteration. These habits of mind shape our culture and learning environment, and teachers play a central role in making them visible, practiced, and lived each day.

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

Synapse’s After Care program and After Care School Programs give students a safe, engaging, and joyful place to learn and play after the academic day ends. Families depend on these programs being reliable and well run, and this role treats that dependability as the core of the job.

Synapse School has a full time opening for an After Care Coordinator for the 2026-27 school year. The After Care Coordinator will help manage Synapse’s After School Program vendors as well as Synapse’s internal After Care program, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and well cared for after the academic day ends. The role works closely with external vendors, Synapse faculty and staff who host programs, families, and the Business Manager.

We are looking for someone who loves kids, is highly reliable and safety-minded, is comfortable managing a wide age range from TK through 8th grade at the same time, is warm and engaging at the end of a long school day, and wants to be part of an exciting team of forward-thinking educators.

**RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING**

*Synapse After Care Operations*

● Design and lead the Synapse After Care program each afternoon alongside a team of After Care staff ● Staff, schedule, supervise, mentor, and support After Care personnel

● Plan and lead engaging activities appropriate to a wide age range, TK through 8th Grade ● Ensure the After Care space and materials are safe, organized, and well maintained

*After School Vendor Programs*

● Coordinate and schedule Vendor After School Programs

● Collect and organize required documents from vendors and instructors (insurance, background checks, etc.)

● Foster strong relationships with external vendors and internal Synapse staff hosting After School Programs ● Observe After School Program sessions and offer constructive feedback and support to instructors

*Safety, Records & Family Communication*

● Ensure the safety and joy of all students in After Care and After School Programs

● Maintain strict safety and sign-out protocols, including verifying authorized pickup ● Keep accurate daily attendance and sign-out records for all programs

● Communicate promptly and clearly with families about program logistics and any incidents ● Coordinate with classroom teachers on student needs relevant to after-school time ● Collaborate with the Business Manager on billing and payment for all After School programs

**AN IDEAL CANDIDATE WOULD POSSESS THE FOLLOWING QUALIFICATIONS**

● Experience working with a wide range of student age groups, and comfort managing TK through 8th at the same time

● Experience supervising staff or managing a program

● Undergraduate degree required

● Experience in an independent school preferred, but not required

● Highly reliable; families depend on these programs running the same way, every day ● Safety-minded, with strict attention to sign-out and pickup protocols

● Effective group management strategies

● Warm, positive, and engaging with students at the end of a long school day

● Patient and calming presence

● Proactive communicator and collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills ● Organized and able to prioritize efficiently, with comfort using a variety of online organizational tools ● Flexible and adaptable with creative problem solving

● Fluent in and able to model Synapse’s Nine Change Maker Outcomes and the Six Seconds emotional intelligence model (Know Yourself, Choose Yourself, Give Yourself) in daily work

● A passion to work cooperatively with colleagues on a consistent basis and actively cultivate an inclusive environment and support a school community grounded in empathy, social responsibility, and an appreciation and respect for individual differences

**SALARY RANGE AND BENEFITS**

$78,000 -$95,000

Synapse offers a generous benefits package including health, dental, and retirement, as well as additional lifestyle perks. Housing stipends available to those who qualify.

Applicants should email a cover letter of interest

They are not tied to a specific app or product, but instead work across the company, leveraging expertise in survey research, metric development, causal inference, large-scale data analysis, and qualitative methods like cognitive testing and focus groups. DSS is known for designing and implementing robust measurement and research approaches to address complex, cross-product challenges, such as evaluating machine learning models and improving user and behavior measurement. Research Program Managers build and scale global research programs to strengthen the impact of our research teams. We drive efficiency, cultivate relationships, increase knowledge sharing, and build capacity within our organization to enable Researchers to do their most impactful work. As a Research Program Manager, DSS Research Operations, you will work in conjunction with the existing DSS ResOps team and the larger Global Research Organization team to identify overlaps and synergies between research programs and practices across DSS enabling increased research effectiveness. In this role, you will define, establish, and maintain global operational and team-wide programs as well as create, manage, and scale processes to support the growing team. You'll utilize a full range of organizational and effective communication to help our team operate at their highest and most effective level.  
  
  

### **Research Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Define and manage strategic initiatives that improve team efficiency and impact, establishing operational systems and outcomes
* Proactively identify and partner with stakeholders on internal processes, templates, and guidelines to improve team optimization and documentation
* Partner with team leadership on establishing effective team communication, information distribution, and cross-team collaboration
* Partner with cross-functional teams such as Sourcing and Vendor Engagements to enable customized DSS contracting processes
* Manage relationship with select group of preferred vendors, building the business-specific operations and processes needed to streamline intake
* Support research planning and allocation by tracking, aligning and executing project specific contracting/PO’s and invoice tracking against open PO’s

* Perform data analysis and provide insights to inform and support business decisions
* Prepare metric-driven status reports by gathering, analyzing and summarizing relevant information
* Proactively manage expectations: define clear program roadmaps, provide frequent program updates, identify and communicate risks and adjustments, and ensure commitments are delivered
* Provide adaptable approaches that meet team needs, including the ability to adapt approaches based on shifting priorities and remove obstacles by escalating or proposing alternatives
* Serve as a link to the Global Research Ops team, leveraging new processes or best practices when relevant and collaborating on programs specific to the team’s needs
* Facilitate relationships between teams, move initiatives forward, find resources, escalate and raise concerns to appropriate owners early and resolve open issues that prevent progress

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in program management, research operations, or a related field
* Experience with establishing programs and leading them end-to-end while scaling for growth
* Experience integrating AI tools and workflows into business operations or program management
* Demonstrated ability to drive responsible and ethical AI adoption in cross-functional settings
* Demonstrated ability to translate AI/ML concepts for business stakeholders
* Experience building relationships with peers and executive stakeholders and collaborating with cross-functional teams across multiple locations
* Experience leveraging data to inform decisions and drive change
* Track record of identifying process gaps and independently designing and implementing solutions in evolving or undefined environments
* Experience managing competing deadlines by prioritizing tasks based on impact and stakeholder needs, and identifying and resolving blockers to maintain project momentum
* Experience communicating program status, risks, and recommendations to researchers, cross-functional stakeholders, organizational leaders, and external partners, with experience adapting communication style to suit different audiences

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with vendor management and contract negotiation
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Track record of leading or supporting AI transformation initiatives in a business context
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated track record of (1) organization and (2) prioritization approaches and frameworks
* Experience working directly with UX researchers, Finance, and Legal teams
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with AI/ML-powered products, business process automation, or AI-driven analytics

-----------

Psychologist Program Managers have broad responsibility for managing one or more programs that deliver specialized, complex, and highly professional services. These programs are integral components of the facility and have a significant impact on the health care provided to Veterans.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

NOTE: The 2-page Resume requirement does not apply to this position. This position is open to all U.S. Citizens.

  

**Duties**
----------

This position is located in the Psychology Service. Psychologist program managers have broad program management responsibilities for a specific program or programs that are designed to deliver specialized, complex, highly professional services that are important program components of the facility and that significantly impact the health care provided to Veterans. Decisions made by the Program Manager affect staff and other resources associated with the programs managed and are made while exercising wide latitude and independent judgment. The specific position requires expertise in one or more of the following areas, including neuropsychology, geropsychology/extended care, and/or inpatient mental health.

* Responsibility includes supervision of psychology staff associated with the program and/or assigned by the Chief of Psychology.
* Responsible for strategic planning to ensure the provision of high-quality services to meet the needs of the Veterans being served.

**Clinical Responsibilities (35% of time):**

* Assists with planning and overseeing the completion of research programs designed to provide information regarding program planning and relevant treatment approaches as needed.

**Other Significant Responsibilities (approximately 5% time):**

* Serves on Medical Center or Healthcare System, VISN, and/or National VA committees or task forces as needed.

jobs.description:
**PROGRAM MANAGER (SUD/MH)**

**BEHAVIORAL HEALTH SERVICES**

*Full-time, Exempt*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Position Title:** Program Manager, Behavioral Health Services

**Reports To:** Executive Director

**Program Summary:** Horizons’ behavioral health programs provide culturally-rooted substance use early intervention and mental health services and opportunities for youth, their families and the broader community. Our programs address their complex needs through screening/assessment, Brief Intervention Services, harm reduction workshops, case management, therapy, wellness groups, care coordination and other healing-centered strategies. Centered on early intervention, low-barrier access, and mild to moderate needs, services are provided in English and Spanish onsite, in the schools and in collaboration with community partners. Our services provide interventions, goal planning, skill building and education for clients to develop a sustainable approach to recovery and healing.

**Position Description:** The Program Manager will be responsible for managing the substance use early intervention program and low-barrier mental health services. Services are community-based and facilitated through grant partnerships with the SF Department of Public Health and the Roadmap To Peace collaborative. Essential duties include but are not limited to development, management and administration of program and contracts; development of work plans, data collection, analysis and reporting for billing, compliance, quality assurance and evaluation; recruitment, hiring and supervision of staff, intake/caseload coordination, service coverage and delivery, etc.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Daily Operations and Service Flow Management**

* Implement promising and best practices for healing-centered and trauma-informed services.
* Serve as lead and point of contact for services, referrals and coordination of care.
* Facilitate timely and low-barrier access to services through strategic outreach and partnership development.
* Conduct timely referral screening, client assignment and internal referral tracking.
* Develop, manage, and account for program services in fidelity with program values and funding contracts.
* Design, implement, oversee, and monitor data collection and documentation practices.
* Communicate with partner agencies about referrals, program activities, and staff.
* Ensure compliance standards for all clinical staff to provide billable services.
* Assess clinical training needs and implement appropriate skill building opportunities.
* Manage program budgets and practice fidelity with compliance.
* Lead team meetings to assess progress, discuss needs, and monitor deliverables.
* Co-lead bi-weekly Clinical Admin team meetings.

**Supervision and Staff Support**

* Supervise, evaluate, coach, and support staff in their roles.
* Provide direct services and coverage as needed.
* Develop internal systems to support all aspects of program activities, including utilization review process, audit, managing clinical productivity, timely billing, performance tracking, reporting, training, etc.

**Documentation, Reporting, and Compliance**

* Implement evaluation strategies to measure the impact of service delivery.
* Ensure staff are trained in proper documentation policies and protocols.
* Track/report productivity of all staff providing services under contracts.
* Run and reconcile monthly billing and service data reports.
* Coordinate monthly and annual chart reviews and audits as required by SFDPH.
* Collaborate with clinical and admin staff to facilitate timely and accurate documentation and billing.
* Maintain and update Outpatient Operational manual and other contract, compliance, and administrative policies and procedures.
* Implement and ensure compliance with program and agency systems, practices, and procedures.
* Represent behavioral health programs at events and meetings.
* Other duties as assigned by the Executive Director.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Must be CA Licensed or license eligible (registered with the Board of Behavioral Sciences or Board of Psychology).
* Three (3) years of experience providing substance use treatment and mental health services to youth and families.
* Three (3) years experience managing contracts, developing systems to track compliance and meeting annual performance goals.
* Two (2) years experience supervising staff.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Superb organizational skills and ability to manage several competing priorities.
* Detailed oriented with an aptitude for data collection, entry, and reconciliation.
* Skilled in developing and monitoring systems to ensure program alignment, compliance and impact.
* Experience working with newcomers, systems impacted, and youth that may not traditionally access services.
* Ability to supervise and motivate staff to excel professionally and meet program goals.
* Able to maintain confidential, accurate, and complete records including documentation of daily service encounters, monthly and quarterly reports, etc.
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently.

jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

The Strategic Materials Program Manager will be the operational linchpin for our most critical, high-value components. These components feature complex supply chains, custom manufacturing processes, and high field-rework value. To orchestrate material availability across diverse demand streams, you will leverage MRP systems and AI-driven forecasting tools to review historical trends, compare scenarios, and lead rigorous capacity planning. This role owns cross-functional communication, publishes regular planning reports for leadership, and partners directly with Procurement to ensure alignment. It is an opportunity to drive high-impact supply chain visibility from raw material mill runs to final asset delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end material flow and inventory visibility for critical components
* Coordinate and reconcile material requirements and allocations across multiple operational teams including Production, Project Delivery, O&M, and R&D
* Lead capacity planning and line of balance reviews with internal manufacturing teams and external stakeholders to identify and resolve throughput constraints
* Review consumption trends, build comparisons, and evaluate forecasts using MRP systems and AI-driven forecasting tools to publish comprehensive planning reports
* Partner closely with Procurement to review inventory coverage, align purchase order (PO) schedules with operational demand horizons, and prevent supply gaps
* Own cross-functional communication by gathering operational inputs and delivering transparent executive reporting on material health and schedule risks to leadership

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of material requirements planning (MRP) and production scheduling logic
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and demand signals
* Proficiency in managing ERP planning modules and optimizing system parameters
* Exceptional communication skills to bridge gaps between Engineering, Production, and Procurement

### **Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in materials management or supply chain planning in a manufacturing environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related technical field
* Advanced technical proficiency with MRP and ERP systems
* Proven track record of leading capacity planning, line of balance reviews, and cross-functional operations alignment with external suppliers
* Direct experience managing high-value, long-lead, custom-manufactured components or complex component lifecycles
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to present complex data insights clearly to cross-functional teams and executive leadership
* Proficiency in utilizing AI and automation tools (e.g., LLMs, spreadsheet automation) to streamline material planning workflows, accelerate documentation, and reduce manual reporting time
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, data modeling)
* Cultural fit: Rigorous Accuracy (attention to detail, process-oriented), Pragmatic Problem Solving (finding solutions in supply constraints), and Proactive Collaboration

This position is Hybrid/Remote or Onsite at our **Menlo Park HQ**. The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well as the experience of the employee. Along with base salary, Mainspring offers pre-IPO company equity through Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) + benefits.

Does your experience not meet all of our posted requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to positions unless they meet every listed requirement. At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you. Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background.

In more traditional words, Mainspring Energy, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

This compensation and benefits information is based on Mainspring Energy's estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future. We generally do not negotiate on salary once we have made an offer. The level of pay within the range will depend on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant prior experience and/or education, or particular skills and expertise. New hires joining the company tend to be paid within the starting base pay range noted above, with opportunities to increase pay over time based on development of additional skills, competencies, and company-specific knowledge.

**About Superhuman**
--------------------

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You’ll help run Superhuman’s unified audit program: quarterly audit activities across SOC 2, the ISO 27000 family, ISO 42001, and our other certifications. You’ll work with our audit firms, GRC Partners, and control owners across Superhuman, and plan new audits as we expand to new frameworks, platforms, and regions. You’ll also run gap assessments that show what each expansion will take before we commit.

You’ll build the audit operating model and runbook, and drive automation so evidence can be collected and reused across frameworks where possible, requests to control owners are streamlined, and each audit cycle takes less effort than the last. Building with AI tools is a normal part of the job, with appropriate human oversight.

This is an individual contributor role for a program manager who communicates clearly, manages competing priorities, and enjoys simplifying complex processes.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Run the audit program as one program: an integrated plan and calendar across audits and expansions, with milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions tracked, and regular status updates to GRC leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan and run quarterly audits from scoping through report and findings closeout, including readiness ahead of each fieldwork window (control owner prep, evidence pre-checks, walkthrough dry runs).
* Scope each audit’s boundary with Product and Engineering, and flag when a launch or new platform changes it.
* Build and maintain the audit operating model and runbook as the program grows.
* Drive automation of evidence collection, request tracking, and audit reporting. Work with GRC Engineering on new ways to generate and collect evidence, and reuse evidence and walkthroughs across frameworks where applicable.
* Partner with GRC and Procurement on third-party risk management across the vendor lifecycle.
* Align audit windows across frameworks and firms to minimize duplicate evidence requests to control owners.
* Plan new audits and expansions, and run framework and scope evaluations and gap assessments with recommendations and effort estimates leadership can act on.
* Work with control owners and GRC Partners to deliver evidence and close findings, and coordinate with GRC Partners on findings requiring extended remediation.
* Manage day-to-day auditor relationships, and report audit status, findings, and program metrics to GRC leadership.

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of program management experience running multi-workstream programs with plans, milestones, dependencies, risk tracking, and leadership reporting.
* 5+ years running external security audits (SOC 2 and ISO 27001 at minimum), at a company or an audit firm, including seasons with several frameworks at once.
* Working knowledge of SOC 2, the ISO 27000 family, ISO 42001, and PCI-DSS and where their requirements overlap.
* Experience leading a gap assessment for a new framework or scope change and presenting the result to leadership.
* Experience building or improving an audit process: calendars, request tracking, runbooks, roles and responsibilities.
* Technical fluency to understand how evidence is produced in cloud environments, assess the completeness and accuracy of system-generated reports, and identify opportunities for automation using AI tools.
* Ability to communicate clearly, manage competing priorities, and proactively resolve blockers during time-sensitive audit cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, establish accountability, and drive deliverables without direct reporting authority.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience managing complex external audits in an in-house GRC function, consulting environment, or audit firm.
* Familiarity with additional frameworks such as ISO 42001, PCI DSS, ISO 27701 or 27018, CSA STAR, or international schemes (for example, IRAP, ISMAP, or C5).
* Experience automating evidence collection or audit reporting, or using LLMs day-to-day to plan, track, and report on program work.
* Experience with a GRC platform or building lightweight internal tooling.
