jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Lead Clinical Case Manager**

**Essex Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting on the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their careers.

**Program Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s The Essex Supportive Services Program provides on-site clinical case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include clinical case management and behavioral health counseling, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. Felton is committed to implementing evidence-based practices and behavioral health research within its community-based mental health services. All clinicians registered with the CA Board of Behavioral Health Sciences (BBS) will receive weekly clinical supervision for licensure.

**Job Description**

The Lead Clinical Case Manager is a licensed or BBS registered clinician with direct service experience and works with individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, mental health needs, and medical complexity. Under the Program Director, this is a supervisory and leadership position that will lead the team in the day-to-day operations. This position holds a full caseload, leads staff meetings, assists with various compliance processes, attends relevant HSH meetings, and takes on specialized improvement projects. The Lead Clinical Case Manager participates in a multidisciplinary team, including communications with external and internal agency team members consisting of mental health clinicians, primary care providers, nurses, peer specialists, interns, and psychiatric medication providers. The program serves 84 tenants at the Essex Hotel. The Lead Clinical Case Manager will also coordinate closely with property management partners and collaboratively conduct wellness and emergency safety checks. The Lead Clinical Case Manager will coordinate the monthly group schedule and community meetings. This supervisory position provides structure and program development. The Lead Clinical Case Manager provides specialized mental health services, including therapy, rehabilitative skills training, crisis intervention, and case management. Services may include crisis intervention, connection to community resources, client advocacy, and engagement strategies. The Lead Clinical Case Manager ensures that the entire team maintains accurate, detailed records of client contacts and incident reports as required by Felton, HSH, ONE system, and county and state regulations.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Supervises the interdisciplinary team onsite to provide onsite support to tenants.
* Creates a welcoming community milieu within the building and acts as a point person in collaborating with property management and HSH to support tenants in maintaining stable independent housing.
* Attend appropriate meetings with building partners, funders, and external partners, as directed. Oversee the documentation of the community specialists and case managers, building capacity and expertise within the team.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who can operate at the intersection of data engineering and business strategy. This is not a traditional CSM role where you send check-in emails and track NPS scores. You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers — helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and ensuring they renew and grow.

The "technical" in the title is real. Our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders. They talk in SQL, think in data models, and evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. You need to be credible in those conversations while also being the person who can walk into a QBR with a VP of Data and connect platform metrics to business outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Customer Success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own customer outcomes. Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts end-to-end — from onboarding through renewal. You're accountable for implementation, retention, adoption, and expansion within your book of business.
* Run strategic QBRs. Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews that go beyond usage dashboards. You'll analyze deployment health, surface adoption gaps, build ROI narratives, and give customers a clear roadmap for getting more value from Cube.
* Get technical. Understand how customers have modeled their data in Cube, diagnose performance issues (pre-aggregation strategy, query optimization, caching behavior), and advise on best practices. You won't build data models day-to-day, but you need to read them, reason about them, and guide customers toward better architecture.
* Be the voice of the customer internally. Translate customer feedback into actionable product insights. Work closely with engineering, product, and solutions architecture to resolve issues and influence the roadmap.
* Drive adoption of new capabilities. Cube's platform is evolving fast — Analytics Chat, embedded agentic analytics, MCP integration, workbooks and dashboards. You'll help customers understand what's new, why it matters for their use case, and how to adopt it.
* Manage renewals and identify expansion opportunities. You'll own the commercial relationship alongside our sales team. This means understanding contract timelines, building the business case for renewal, and spotting natural expansion paths — more users, embedded analytics, additional environments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Must-haves:

* 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a data, analytics, or developer-tools company (CSM, technical account manager, solutions consultant, or similar)
* Strong SQL skills — you can write queries with window functions, CTEs, and cohort logic, and you can read someone else's SQL and spot what's wrong
* Experience working with technical stakeholders (data engineers, analytics engineers, engineering managers) and executive stakeholders (VP/Head of Data, CTO) in the same account
* Track record of managing renewals and driving account growth in a SaaS environment
* Ability to run a QBR that a data leader would actually find valuable — business narrative, not just metrics
* Familiarity with the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), transformation tools (dbt), and BI/analytics tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain a pre-aggregation strategy to a data engineer and explain ROI to a VP in the same meeting
* Based in the US with availability for overlap with US business hours

Nice-to-haves:

* Experience with Cube or semantic layer concepts (metrics layers, governed data models, headless BI)
* Background in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI — you've been on the practitioner side
* Familiarity with embedded analytics use cases and multi-tenant architectures
* Experience with API-first or developer-tool products where the buyer is technical
* Understanding of AI/LLM integrations in the data stack (MCP, text-to-SQL, agentic workflows)
* Comfort with light data modeling, YAML/code-based configuration, or git workflows

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and generous stock options in a growing company
* Unlimited PTO — we actually use it
* Remote-first culture with coworking space stipend if you prefer not working from home
* Team offsites several times a year (locations rotate between the US and Europe)
* Professional development budget — training courses, books, conferences
* The chance to work on a product that sits at the center of the modern data stack and the AI-native future

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* Introductory call — 30 min with the recruiting team
* Hiring manager conversation — 45 min to discuss your experience, approach, and what you're looking for
* Take-home exercise — prepare and present a mock QBR using a provided data pack (~3–4 hours of prep + 30 min live presentation)
* Cross-functional interviews — conversations with team mem

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City (Primary), Denver, Chicago, Singapore (APAC), London, San Francisco, Austin, Los Angeles  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who can help channel partners bring Endex to customers with a clear, consistent sales motion.

As a Channel Account Manager at Endex, you'll manage commercial performance across an assigned set of referral or reseller partners. You'll work with direct sales to turn partner engagement into qualified opportunities and closed business.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Channel Accounts:** Build account plans and relationships across your assigned partners.
* **Build Partner-Sourced Pipeline:** Map target accounts with partner sellers, qualify opportunities and maintain clear deal registration and attribution.
* **Run Co-Selling:** Coordinate discovery, demonstrations, proposals and close plans with direct sales and partner account teams.
* **Clarify Ownership:** Keep account coverage, partner attribution and direct-sales responsibilities explicit.
* **Improve Channel Performance:** Review sourced and influenced pipeline separately, forecast live opportunities and address gaps in partner execution.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Channel Experience:** You've worked with partners on a repeatable B2B sales motion.
* **Sales Discipline:** You know how to qualify opportunities and maintain a credible forecast.
* **Relationship Depth:** You build connections beyond a single partner contact.
* **Clear Coordination:** You keep multiple sellers aligned without confusing the customer.
* **Commercial Accountability:** You have worked toward partner-driven pipeline or revenue goals and can explain how you converted relationships into signed business.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with reseller or referral programs
* Enterprise software sales experience
* Knowledge of channel agreements and attribution

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Health & Dental Insurance
* Monthly Wellness Stipend
* 401K Matching

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager- Hyperscaler
jobs.description:
Molex is seeking a dynamic and proactive Account Manager to join our highly visible team. Role will support one of our Tier 1 global accounts while working for one of the top interconnect solutions providers in the world. As an Account Manager you will be tasked with growing topline revenue and profit. This is achieved but managing existing portfolio while driving new opportunities.

This position carries a high degree of autonomy and will be the primary interface between our customer and Molex. You will have the responsibility for educating this important customer on the value Molex brings to their business. Along with being the primary point of contact with all levels of the client's organization. You will also interface with many internal Molex roles in support of this customers including, but not limited to, Sales & Marketing team, Product Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Finance.

What You Will Do in Your Role

* Managed focused business units at customer to achieve or surpass assigned revenue targets as well as assigned demand creation pipeline goals. Track and document these actions and results in our Customer Relationship Management tool.
* Find desirable revenue opportunities and present to Business Units for necessary support.
* Track and coordinate demand creation business transitioned to other parts of the world to assure Molex captures this business.
* Ongoing development of personal expertise is critical to success in this role.
* Become an expert in understanding this customer's individual strategic business plans.
* Develop and maintain engineering relationships in all your assigned and continually develop technical product skills to effectively sell a wide breadth of Molex offerings.

  
Requirements:
  

* Bachelor's degree in business or a technical discipline, or other related field
* 5+ years of experience in a sales or account manager role within the electronics or interconnect industry
* 5+ years of experience calling on OEM's that design in consumer products with a proven track record of design wins
* Ability to understand customer needs and effectively sell solutions to both the customer and supporting Molex business unit
* Ability to effectively build strategic customer and distributor relationships across a broad span of roles to maximize Molex's ability to win business
* Travel 30-40% annual domestic and international travel

What Will Put You Ahead

* Bachelor's degree, or advanced, in Engineering (preferably BSEE, Physics, or Optics), MBA

  
For this role, we anticipate paying $130,000 - $180,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

**Hiring Philosophy**

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

**Who We Are**

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

**Our Benefits**

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

**Equal Opportunities**

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. jobs.title: Lead Case Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Lead Case Manager**

**Zygmunt Arendt Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 50+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting on the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their careers.

**Program and Division Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s Zygmunt Arendt Supportive Services Program provides on-site case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include case management, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. Felton is committed to implementing evidence-based practices and research within its community-based services.

**Job Description**

Under the supervision of the Program Director, the Lead Case Manager works in direct service with individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, mental health needs, and medical complexity. This is a supervisory and leadership position that will lead the team in day-to-day operations. The Lead Case Manager directly supervises and works with the interdisciplinary team to reach out and engage all tenants, assess their needs upon move-in and throughout their residency, connect tenants to services, and work together to overcome obstacles to retain housing stability. This position will carry a full caseload, leading staff meetings, assisting with various compliance processes, attending relevant HSH meetings, and taking on specialized improvement projects. This team member connects tenants to services including benefits, vocational or educational resources, mental health, medical, substance use services, and any other appropriate resources, as needed. The Lead Case Manger will guide the team to conduct independent living skills, communication skills, social skills, and other necessary groups and activities to support independence, maintain housing stability, and promote mental health recovery. This supervisory position provides structure and program development. The Lead Case Manager will also coordinate closely with property management partners and collaboratively conduct wellness and emergency safety checks. This person will also bring expertise regarding the specific needs of older adults and those entering housing from homelessness, as well as aging physical and mental health needs. The Lead Case Manager ensures that the entire team maintains accurate, detailed records of client contacts and incident reports as required by Felton, HSH, ONE system, and county and state regulations. This person will also bring expertise regarding the specific needs of older adults and those entering housing from homelessness, as well as connections to community resources, recreational opportunities, and other connections to necessary services.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or related fields of study required.
* Work closely with an interdisciplinary team and collaborate with property management.
* Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with all internal and external team members and with partnering agencies.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Perform intakes and service plan development for adults with a history of being unhoused and other psychiatric or medical conditions or disabilities.
* Provide case management services, which could include connection to primary care, coordination with other providers and community resources, housing stabilization services, etc. Link tenants to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Maintain records of each client contact or service in accordance with mandated standards of HSH and Felton. Meet requirements of timely access for client care and documentation.
* Participate in team meetings and case conferences through presentation of cases, discussion of issues, and exchange of information and ideas.
* Provide crisis intervention to prevent hospitalization and collaborate with clinicians or other providers as needed. Respond to emergency situations as they arise.
* Commit to ongoing training, including developing specializations in evidence-based practices.
* Use the ONE and CIRCE systems to maintain client records related to housing per HSH standards.
* Deliver exceptional customer service to tenants, community partners, and team.
* Address specific housing needs via training, coaching, or community resource referrals to support tenants in maintaining stable housing.
* Provide emergency wellness checks.
* Passionate about working with older adults who may be isolated, have mental health issues, have cognitive impairments, substance abuse issues, or other needs that are not being met.

jobs.title: Substance Use Disorder Case Manager
jobs.description:
**SUBSTANCE USE DISORDER CASE MANAGER**

**ROADMAP TO PEACE INITIATIVE, BEHAVIORAL HEALTH DEPARTMENT**

*Full-time, Union Position*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Summary:** The Roadmap To Peace (RTP) initiative is a collective impact program that advances economic, health and safety outcomes for Latino/a identified, disconnected youth ages 13-24, who are in-risk and/or violence involved. RTP is a collaboration of seven community based service providers and has three interrelated strategies: Healing through a culturally responsive service network, community building activities, and policy reform.

**Position Description:** The Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Case Manager is responsible for coordinating the SUD prevention and early intervention services within the RTP Initiative and providing service navigation, linkage and advocacy to clients. This role involves receiving referrals, conducting SUD screenings, providing SUD brief intervention services, and facilitating a minimum of six SUD harm reduction workshops annually. The Case Manager connects clients and/or their family members to both on- and off-site services, including employment, education and other resources. They provide ongoing case management to support client access to services, care coordination, and linkage to appropriate providers. This position carries a caseload of up to six youth at any given time and a total of eight youth throughout the year.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Conduct outreach activities to engage RTP youth in SUD services.
* Network and collaborate with schools, agency staff, probation/parole officers, and other partners to raise awareness of RTP initiatives and expand access to services.
* Conduct SUD screenings to determine client’s SUD risks and needs.
* Facilitate SUD Brief Intervention Services.
* Make referrals to partner organizations for clients in need of SUD treatment.
* Develop and facilitate a minimum of six SUD harm reduction workshops annually.
* Conduct client intakes and complete comprehensive case management assessments for all clients entering the caseload.
* Provide case management services to 8 clients per year.
* Facilitate referrals through effective interagency collaboration and networking.
* Maintain ongoing supportive services based on goals identified in the client’s case plan.
* Provide care coordination with internal/external partners to ensure wrap around support.
* Provide court advocacy, letters of support and resources to support youth’s legal needs.
* Actively participate in RTP-sponsored community activities, including day, evening and weekend trips when appropriate.
* Ensure all client documentation, case files, and service logs are current and compliant with agency and funder requirements, maintaining strict confidentiality.
* Complete all required reports, along with daily data entry and service tracking logs.
* Mandatory participation in the monthly service network meetings, RTP academy sessions and annual townhall and community hosted activities and/or events
* Support agency-wide efforts by participating in 1-2 community-wide and/or agency committees/collectives aligned with program and organizational values.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Behavioral Health Program Director.

**Experience and Qualification**

* Bilingual (Spanish/English).
* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Sciences and/or equivalent experience with at least two years of case management experience and SUD services experience.
* Adept in conducting intakes and case plan development and tracking.
* Able to conduct SUD screenings and provide Brief Intervention Services.
* Confident in developing and facilitating SUD harm reduction workshops.
* Must be detail oriented, deadline driven, and able to work independently and take initiative. Knowledge of youth service providers in San Francisco.
* Knowledge of trauma-informed care, clinical interventions and approaches to youth development, behavior modification, restorative justice practices and harm reduction.
* Experience working with youth within the juvenile justice system, adult probation, the "re-entry" population, youth with disabilities, youth with co-occurring disorders, and/or street-affiliated, etc.
* Experience working in partnership with other community agencies.
* Able to maintain confidential, accurate, and complete records including documentation of daily encounters, progress notes, weekly and monthly reports, etc.
* Excellent organizational, communication, written, and verbal skills.
* Ability to work as a member of a team and during non-traditional hours (morning, evenings and weekends).

**Job Requirements**

* Ability to provide verification of degree(s) and licenses before the start date.
* Must complete all requirements needed to maintain licensure/certification.
* Must be able to clear a TB test before the first day of employment and annually.
* Complete annual recurrent required training.
* This position is under the SEIU 1021 collective bargaining agreement and is subject to enrollment.
* If in recovery, must be clean and sober for a minimum of 2 years.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**About Acrisure**
------------------

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services, and more.

In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Acrisure is seeking a Telephonic Nurse Case Manager to support workers’ compensation claims through clinical case management and coordination of care. This role works closely with medical providers, employers, claims professionals, and injured workers to facilitate appropriate treatment, promote recovery, and support safe and effective return to work outcomes.

This is a position operating in a structured, high volume, fast paced environment. Success in this role requires strong organization, adaptability, and the ability to manage multiple cases while maintaining responsiveness, accuracy, and effective communication.

Candidates must have hands-on experience managing workers’ compensation cases, as this is essential to successfully perform in this position.

  

Candidates can be in any US city but must be able to work Mountain or Pacific Time hours.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Manage telephonic case management for workers’ compensation claims, including assessment, care coordination, and ongoing case oversight
* Collaborate with injured workers, healthcare providers, employers, claims representatives, and legal partners to support treatment plans and recovery outcomes
* Evaluate treatment plans and provide guidance based on clinical knowledge and case management best practices
* Facilitate return to work planning and monitor progress toward recovery goals
* Maintain frequent telephonic and written communication with all involved parties throughout the life of the claim
* Advocate for appropriate and cost effective care while supporting positive health outcomes
* Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant documentation of all case activity
* Identify barriers to recovery and implement strategies to improve outcomes
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, company standards, and HIPAA guidelines
* Manage assigned caseload independently, prioritizing work and adjusting plans as needed

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* Strong understanding of workers’ compensation processes, case management practices, and return to work coordination
* Ability to manage a high volume caseload in a structured, metrics driven environment
* Strong communication skills with the ability to navigate complex and sensitive conversations
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to work effectively in a remote setting using multiple systems and screens
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while maintaining productivity and quality standards
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities
* Positive, adaptable mindset with the ability to work effectively in a fast paced environment
* Bilingual (Spanish speaking) skills are highly beneficial

**Required Licenses:**
----------------------

* Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
* Certified Case Manager (CCM)
* Multistate License
* California Nursing License

**Preferred License:**
----------------------

* North Carolina QRP

#LI-JP3

Pay Details:

The base compensation range for this position is $85,000 - $94,000. This range reflects Acrisure's good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Placement within the range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, location, and internal equity.

**Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.**

**Why Join Us:**

At Acrisure, we’re building more than a business, we’re building a community where people can grow, thrive, and make an impact. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future.

Making a lasting impact on the communities it serves, Acrisure has pledged more than $22 million through its partnerships with Corewell Health Helen DeVos Children's Hospital in Grand Rapids, Michigan, UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Blythedale Children's Hospital in Valhalla, New York.

**Employee Benefits**

We also offer our employees a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks, including:

* **Physical Wellness:** Comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; fertility benefits; wellness resources; and paid sick time.
* **Mental Wellness:** Generous paid time off and holidays; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and a complimentary Calm app subscription.
* **Financial Wellness:** Immediate vesting in a 401(k) plan; Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options; commuter benefits; and employee discount programs.
* **Family Care:** Paid maternity leave and paid paternity leave (including for adoptive parents); legal plan options; and pet insurance coverage.
* **… and so much more!**

Our ever-evolving suite of Heath and Wellness products for iPhone and Watch are helping our users live more active, healthier lives. Be ready to make something great when you come here. Our mission is to deliver the world’s best healthcare experiences for Apple employees and their families.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Operations Specialist to be a critical bridge between our clinical, operations, engineering, and design teams. In this role, you will be the voice of the clinician and operations, ensuring that our products meet their needs and improve workflows. You will play a key role in defining, developing, and launching new features, driving adoption, and maximizing their impact. You'll be a core member of the team, representing clinical and operational perspectives and ensuring our products deliver exceptional value.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in engineering, science, business or equivalent field

* A keen eye for building user experiences that are delightful while delivering impact
* Takes initiative, exhibits a high level of accountability, and makes sound decisions under uncertainty
* Stellar interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus at all levels
* A polished communicator with strong executive presence
* Excellent prioritization and time management skills, with the willingness and ability to flex between strategic thinking and tactical execution throughout the day

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* 2+ years serving as the lead Product Manager in a multi-PM organization
* Familiarity with data visualization techniques, healthcare operations and application of software in healthcare setting

jobs.title: Product Manager, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
**Join Us in Building the Future of Home Robotics**

At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 18 months building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

**What to Expect**

Sunday is putting robots into homes — around kids, pets, furniture, and families who haven't lived with a robot before. No regulatory body has defined what "safe" means for a home robot yet. We're defining it ourselves, and our brand depends on getting it right. You'll be our first product manager dedicated to trust and safety. You'll own the safety and privacy requirements for Memo end to end: what we test, what we promise users, and what we refuse to ship. You'll work across robot software, hardware, controls, ML, app, design, and operations to make safety a property of the whole system, not one team's checklist.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the safety and trust roadmap for Memo. Define what "safe enough to ship" means for each release, and hold the line on it.
* Build the system-level safety case. Map failure modes across navigation, hardware, controls, task design, firmware, and user communications, and make sure each has an owner, a test, and a mitigation.
* Work with engineering to define and track safety test coverage for every subsystem. Ensure firmware and software releases are validated against safety requirements before OTA.
* Own data privacy for the product: what Memo records in the home, who can see it (including teleoperators), how long it's kept, and how users understand and control it.
* Design how Memo behaves and communicates around kids, pets, and unexpected situations — stop conditions, warnings, recovery, and what the app tells users.
* Set standards where none exist. Draw on adjacent industries (consumer durables, home fitness equipment, new category products, appliances) to build a safety framework fit for a home robot — without importing process that doesn't apply.
* Run incident review. When something goes wrong in a home or the office, lead the investigation, root cause, and the change that follows.
* Partner with product operations to turn real-home observations into safety requirements.
* Define and track safety metrics: incidents per robot-hour, near-misses, test coverage by subsystem, time-to-mitigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years in product, safety, or quality roles on physical consumer products people touch and live with — think new category products, home fitness equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, or similar. You've shipped hardware into homes where the standards were thin and you had to set them.
* Not required: automotive, aerospace, or medical device background. While this is nice to have, we're looking for judgment in lightly regulated spaces, not fluency in pre-existing regulatory frameworks.
* Detail-oriented. You read the test report, not the summary. You notice the edge case nobody listed.
* Fast technical learner. You can pick up how a navigation stack, a controller, or a firmware release process works well enough to ask the right questions and spot gaps.
* Strong judgment and a deep sense of responsibility. You'll make calls that affect families, and you treat that seriously. You're comfortable being the person who says "not yet."
* Experience working with engineers on test plans, failure analysis, or release gating.
* Familiarity with data privacy principles for connected consumer devices (cameras, in-home sensors).
* Comfort with ambiguity at an early-stage company. You can write the first version of a safety standard that doesn't exist yet.
* Bonus: experience with consumer product safety standards (ASTM, UL, CPSC), in-home cameras or robots, or incident/recall processes.

**What success looks like in 6 months**

* Memo has a written, system-level safety framework with owners and test coverage for every subsystem, used as a release gate.
* Every firmware/software release passes a defined safety validation before OTA.
* Data privacy policy for in-home recording and teleop is defined, implemented in the app, and understandable to users.
* An incident review process is running, and beta learnings are feeding back into requirements.
* Product, hardware, and engineering leads treat the T&S PM as the owner of "is this safe to ship."

At Sunday Robotics, we’re building technology shaped by real people — curious, creative, and diverse. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria — we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

Compensation Range: $180K - $250K

jobs.description:
**About Gusto**

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

### **About the team**

The Security Operations team at Gusto plays a critical role in fortifying Gusto and our customers against sophisticated threats: phishing attacks, insider risks, data loss, and emerging attack techniques. Our distributed team across Eastern and Pacific time zones monitors, investigates, and responds to security events during business hours, with a lightweight rotation for rare after-hours escalation of critical incidents.

We're looking for a Security Operations analyst with 5+ years of experience to own and deliver security operations projects, take an active role in incident response, and raise the bar for how our team detects and responds to threats. You'll work across our multi-cloud environment (AWS, GCP, and others), build Python-based automation, and help govern the fastest-growing part of our attack surface: non-human identities and AI/agent connections. You'll be the directly responsible individual for medium-sized initiatives, work closely with senior analysts, and help mentor newer teammates.

### **Here's what you'll do**

**Own security operations projects end to end.** Take medium-sized initiatives (typically 1-2 months, often spanning multiple teams) from problem definition through design, rollout, and measurement. Break down ambiguous goals into deliverables, set expectations with stakeholders, communicate progress and risks, and drive work to completion.

**Lead and participate in incident response.** Triage, investigate, and respond to security incidents across our cloud and corporate environments. Serve as a core responder, document root cause and remediation, write or contribute to post-mortems, and own the completion of post-mortem action items so lessons turn into lasting improvements.

**Improve detection and monitoring.** Monitor and triage alerts from tools like AWS GuardDuty/Security Hub/WAF, GCP Security Command Center, and our CSPM platform. Tune and improve detections, reduce noise, and recommend configuration and process improvements based on what you learn from investigations.

**Build security operations automation.** Write Python to extend our automation frameworks and SOAR playbooks, reducing manual work and improving response times. Own the quality, testing, and documentation of what you ship.

**Threat hunting.** Hunt for threats across our multi-cloud and corporate environments using threat intelligence and the team's playbooks, and turn findings into new detections or playbooks.

**Non-human identity and agentic AI governance (roughly one-third of your time).** Help govern machine identities, service accounts, and MCP/agent connections that now outnumber human accounts. Drive improvements such as expanding DLP/Nightfall policy coverage for AI and MCP-connected tools, attributing and cleaning up unowned cloud secrets and service accounts, and moving our MCP review process from reactive intake to proactive, risk-based governance.

**AI-assisted security operations.** Use AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Skills, MCP-connected tools) to work faster on querying, investigating, and drafting, and apply sound judgment about risks specific to AI tooling, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through connected tools, and over-permissioned agents. Help set team norms for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

**Collaborate and mentor.** Partner with analyzing, IT, and product teams to support secure practices and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor newer teammates, share what you learn through documentation and knowledge sharing, and contribute to hiring by interviewing candidates.

**Participate in the on-call rotation.** This is a business-hours role with a lightweight on-call rotation for rare after-hours escalations, not a 24/7 pager rotation. You'll join the roster (currently about one week per month, shifting to roughly every 5-6 weeks as the team grows), respond to security incidents, and follow through on post-mortem action items afterward.

### **Here's what we're looking for**

**Minimum requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, SOC analysis, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading or serving as the primary owner of a project or initiative, including coordinating with other teams.
* Hands-on experience responding to security incidents, including investigation, root cause analysis, and post-incident follow-through.
* Working knowledge of security monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with core cloud security services across major providers (AWS, GCP, or similar) and cloud security fundamentals.
* Comfortable working in Linux environments.
* Proficiency in Python for scripting and automation.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise security tools (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, DLP). Deploying or architecting these tools from scratch is not expected at this level.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate findings clearly and escalate

jobs.title: Partner Enablement Specialist 3
jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What's the opportunity?**
---------------------------

Implementation is an activity every Fin customer experiences, whether they're buying Fin for the first time, expanding Fin to a new team, or adopting new features. More and more of those deployments are delivered by our partners, including the Salesforce partner community now ramping up on Fin. A partner-led deployment is only as good as the partner delivering it.

As a Partner Services Manager focused on Enablement, you'll own how our partners get certified and stay current. Your work runs from a partner's first day with Fin, through to the moment they're ready to lead customer deployments, and then every product release after that. Your primary responsibility is making sure every partner who works with a Fin customer has the knowledge, skills and readiness to deliver real value.

Partner Services Managers have an outsized impact on the company. If you want to help make business personal for our customers and you want to work with an ever growing and changing team, you're in the right place!

**What will I be doing?**
-------------------------

* You will own partner enablement end to end: how partners get certified, and how they stay current as Fin evolves
* You will onboard new partners with structured onboarding plans that take them from signed agreement to first deployment, covering Fin's product, our deployment methodology and our delivery standards
* You will run partner certification, including bootcamps, assessments and scenario-based testing. You'll certify named consultants individually, not just partner firms
* You will run Fin Deployment Partner Bootcamps, both in person and virtually, including joint bootcamps with Salesforce for its partner community
* You will build and maintain enablement content, including curricula, online courses, playbooks, hands-on labs and demo environments, and keep it up to date as new features ship
* You will check partner readiness before partners are assigned customer work. That means running readiness assessments, organising shadow and reverse-shadow on live deployments, and confirming that a partner has certified people and capacity in place
* You will track each partner's progress from enabled (delivering under Fin's oversight) to certified (delivering independently), and keep partner and consultant certification records accurate
* You will keep partners current through recertification, release briefings and regular partner office hours
* You will use delivery data, such as Partner CSAT, Fin outcomes, escalations and QA findings, to spot skill gaps and turn them into targeted enablement
* You will own enablement KPIs, including time to certification, certification pass rate, time to first deployment and post-certification delivery quality
* You will work closely with the rest of the Deployment Services team, especially fellow Partner Services Managers and AI Deployment Consultants, to turn lessons from the field into better enablement
* You'll collaborate with our Product, R&D and Education teams to get early access to new features and enable partners on them ahead of launch
* You will cover enablement progress, certification status and skill gaps in each partner's Quarterly Business Review

**What skills do I need?**
--------------------------

* 4+ years of work experience, with 2+ years in implementation, partner enablement or technical training roles
* Enablement Design: experience building training or certification programmes, ideally for partners, consultants or other technical audiences
* Facilitation: confident leading workshops and multi-day bootcamps for technical audiences, both in person and virtually
* Content Creation: the ability to turn complex product and deployment practices into clear courses, guides and hands-on exercises
* Assessment: the judgement to tell whether someone can actually do the work, not just pass a quiz, and the confidence to give direct feedback
* Technical Fluency: comfortable with core SaaS and AI concepts (APIs, integrations, LLM basics, automation logic), enough to speak credibly with technical partner teams
* Programme Management: organised and detail-oriented, able to run several partner cohorts and certification tracks at once
* Positivity and Engagement: a genuine interest in the work you do and a positive attitude!
* Curiosity: a passion for learning, for technology and for solving problems
* Adaptability: change is constant, and the Deployment Services Team values experimentation to find the best processes and solutions
* Demonstrate the Fin Values: Customer Obsessed, Success First, Incredibly High Standards, Open Mindedness, Resilience, Impatience, Positive and Optimistic

-----------------------------

* Requires significant use of personal computer, phone and general office equipment.

* Needs ability to communicate effectively through reading, writing, and speaking in person or on telephone.
* May require off-site travel

None
  
  
DIRECTLY REPORTING
  
Reports to the Supervisor – Payment & Support Operations
  
  
TYPE OF SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
None
  
  
SCOPE AND COMPLEXITY
  
Works independently under general supervision, following defined standards and procedures. Reports to a Supervisor or Manger. Uses critical thinking skills to solve problems and reconcile accounts in a timely manner. External customers include all hospital patients, patient families, and all third-party payers. CIEE is a non-profit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and culturally diverse world.

**Why work with us**:

* You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
* You will receive a competitive total rewards package. CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:

* Paid time off and Parental leave

* Employee Assistance Program

Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

You are an HR professional with strong HRIS, analytical, and operational skills. You are organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing sensitive employee information and complex, deadline-driven processes with a high degree of accuracy. You learn quickly, are naturally curious, and take initiative to work through challenges and solve problems.

You have hands-on experience with HR technology, employee data, compensation administration, payroll, and reporting. You are highly proficient in Excel and comfortable leveraging technology and data tools to analyze information, reconcile data, and support HR processes and reporting. You have experience supporting annual compensation cycles, sales incentive administration, HRIS data management and reporting, and other HR transactions as needed. You are approachable, dependable, and committed to providing responsive, thoughtful support to employees, managers, and HR partners.

**What You’ll Do**:

* Manage ongoing HRIS data audits, identify and resolve discrepancies, and maintain accurate employee, compensation, payroll, and organizational data.

* Advanced Excel skills required, including complex formulas, XLOOKUP or similar lookup functions, PivotTables, data validation, reconciliation, and analysis of large datasets.
* Ability to manage recurring processes, competing priorities, and deadlines independently.
* Effective communicator with excellent written and verbal skills.

jobs.description:
### **About Kasa**

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

### **Role Overview**

Kasa is seeking a People Program Manager to own a defined and evolving slate of People programs, including but not limited to performance scorecards, manager training and enablement, career tracks, the annual performance cycle, and engagement measurement. This role translates strategic organizational priorities into practical, well-run programs.

This role sits within Kasa's People team and reports to the Director of People & Performance. It's an individual contributor, program-ownership role: hands-on, analytically strong, and comfortable building repeatable systems end to end. This People Program Manager will work closely with our Senior People Business Partner, and the two roles are intended to work in close partnership with clear swim lanes. The priorities of this role are to:

* **Build programs that run without being chased.** Own the systems behind how we evaluate, develop, and grow people, and use AI and automation to keep them repeatable and scalable.
* **Equip managers to lead well.** Give our people managers the tools and training to coach their teams, give useful feedback, and grow talent.
* **Give leaders a clear view of team health.** Turn People data into insights and recommendations that help us spot trends and retention risks early and act on them.

**Performance Scorecards & Manager Enablement**

* Build performance scorecards that give managers ongoing visibility into team health and impact

**Performance Review Cycle**

* Own the annual performance cycle end-to-end, including timeline, communications, calibration, and tooling

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity.

  

Families come to Imagine Pediatrics with real needs: a medication refill, a piece of medical equipment, a benefits application, follow-up after a hospital stay. As a Staff Product Manager, you'll own the systems that make sure each of those needs is captured, has a clear owner on our care team, and actually gets delivered on. This is how we turn our care model into meaningful value for families.

AI is central to how we'll do this at scale. You'll decide where AI and automation can take coordination work off our care teams so they spend their time on families instead of tracking, routing and chasing work, and you'll prove it with measured results.

Our care model blends virtual and in-home care for children with special health care needs and their families. The product you own is where care teams see what families need, pick up the work and finish it, every day.

  

**What You'll Own**

Product area: How family needs are captured, assigned, tracked and resolved across our care teams. That includes the shared view of patients and work care teams use every day; tasking and handoffs between roles; messaging with families by chat, text and email; internal care team communication; and follow-up after hospital discharges.

AI and automation in care coordination to:

* capture needs from family conversations and messages
* route and assign work to the right person
* prioritize what's most urgent
* summarize a need's history for whoever picks it up next
* flag needs that are stalling before a family feels it

You'll set the bar for where AI belongs, where it doesn't, and how we measure whether it's working.

* Primary users: Navigators, nurses, resource specialists, pharmacists and other care team members coordinating care. Families are users too, through the messages and updates they receive.
* North star: % of family needs resolved within target time. You'll also track how quickly each need gets a named owner, how many needs stall without progress, and how much care team time goes to coordination overhead rather than to families.
* First-year outcomes:
  + Every family need has a named owner and a visible status, and care teams stop working across fragmented tools.
  + One shared view of the patients and work each care team owns, prioritized by what's most urgent for families.
  + AI-assisted capture, routing or prioritization in production, with a measured reduction in coordination time and no drop in quality.

Other teams depend on what you build. Outreach routes newly enrolled families into your care team views, and the family app shows families the status of their needs. Your decisions shape their roadmaps.

  

**What You'll Do**

*Set direction in ambiguous problem spaces*

* Define the multi-quarter strategy for how family needs are captured, owned, worked and resolved across care teams.
* Frame problems by synthesizing input from clinical leaders, care teams, operations and data, often before anyone has named the problem.
* Turn open-ended operational problems into a clear strategy, and make decisions with incomplete information when waiting would cost families.

*Challenge how the work gets done*

* Push stakeholders to examine their operational workflows: why each step exists, what can be simplified or automated, and what won't scale as we grow.
* Don't digitize a broken process; redesign the workflow first, then build for it.
* Say no, with clear reasoning, to requests that don't move outcomes, and hold that boundary with senior stakeholders.

*Lead with AI where it creates real leverage*

* Identify the coordination work best suited to AI and automation, and the places where human judgment has to stay in the loop.
* Partner with engineering and data to take AI features from prototype to production, with clear evaluation criteria, safety guardrails and care team trust.
* Measure AI by the outcomes it moves (time saved, needs resolved faster, fewer dropped handoffs), not by what launched.

*Drive discovery and execution at scale*

* Own the full product lifecycle for your area using a build–measure–learn approach.
* Lead discovery directly with care teams to understand real workflows, clinical realities and operational constraints.
* Sequence migrations off legacy tools, make hard scope tradeoffs and ship improvements that compound.

*Lead cross-functionally without authority*

* Partner with engineering, clinical leaders, care teams, data and operations to design workflows that hold up in the real world.
* Broker tradeoffs between product, clinical workflows and operational capacity with senior stakeholders.
* Define how other teams plug into care coordination (how work reaches care teams and how families see progress on their needs), and influence their roadmaps where they depend on you.

*Own outcomes, not output*

* Own the success metrics for care coordination and hold the org accountable to them, for both family outcomes and care team efficiency.
* Drive adoption with care teams, not just launches: a system only works if teams actually work from it.
* Kill or rework what isn't moving the numbers.

*Raise the bar*

* Mentor other PMs and model strong discovery, writing, prioritization and decision-making.
* Become a recognized internal expert in pediatric care coordination and AI-enabled care operations.

  

**What You Bring & How You Qualify**

First and foremost, you're motivated by improving the health and lives of children with special health care needs and their fami

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington, D.C., and Brussels with staff working virtually around the world.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

The Contracts and Legal Operations Manager will support CATF's General Counsel and work directly with program and operations teams on contracts, grants, compliance, and day-to-day legal operations. The role combines hands-on contract administration with responsibility for helping staff navigate legal intake and compliance processes, maintaining accurate records, and improving the systems that support this work. You will handle routine matters independently, use sound judgment to identify issues, and escalate more complex legal questions to the General Counsel. Overall, this role helps CATF manage contracts and compliance work consistently and efficiently across the organization.

**Responsibilities**

* **Contracts & Grant Operations** – Manage the administrative lifecycle of contracts and grants, including intake, approval routing, signature coordination, executed-document management, supporting documentation for payment release, and tracking.

* **Compliance Operations** – Manage administrative support for lobbying and electoral compliance, monitor registered agent portals for new issues or filings, and maintain accurate compliance-related information and records.

* **Training & Staff Enablement** – Develop and lead training and office hours that help staff understand legal intake processes and compliance workflows, and prepare supporting guidance, materials, and presentations.
* **Systems & Process Improvement** – Improve workflows and operational efficiency, support system implementations and updates, and help manage contract and document management systems, including reporting and tracking.
* **Policy, Template & Records Management** – Support updates to contract templates, organizational policies, procedures, and guidelines; maintain organized legal files; and manage the internal trademark tracker, including application statuses, renewal deadlines, and office actions.
* **Research & Legal Operations Support** – Conduct legal, industry, and historical research; monitor relevant legal cases and developments; and provide additional administrative support to the General Counsel as needed.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

You will be successful in this role if you can manage detailed legal and operational work while keeping processes moving across multiple teams. The work requires sound judgment, strong organization, and the ability to distinguish between matters you can resolve independently and those that need to be elevated to the General Counsel.

**Required Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to manage contracts, grants, or comparable document-based workflows from intake through approval, execution, recordkeeping, and follow-up.

* Ability to exercise professional judgment, resolve routine issues independently, and recognize when legal or compliance matters require escalation.
* Experience maintaining accurate records, trackers, document management systems, or similar operational systems.
* Ability to work directly with colleagues across different functions and explain processes, requirements, and next steps clearly.
* Experience developing or improving workflows, procedures, training materials, or operational guidance.
* Ability to conduct research, organize findings, and monitor ongoing developments relevant to legal or compliance work.

**What We Provide**

This role supports the legal and compliance infrastructure that allows CATF's teams to carry out their work effectively. The position is remote, with an East Coast location preferred.

Remote

With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

### **Position Overview**

  

Agiloft is looking for a Sales Enablement Program Manager to build the programs that keep our go-to-market teams ramped, current, and ready drive growth to win. You'll own enablement programs from discovery to delivery, and ongoing skills development for product launches, certifications, and sales excellence that empower reps to achieve their targets.

You'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and RevOps to turn business priorities into measurable programs. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role for someone who builds programs, runs them, and proves their business impact with data.

### **Job Responsibilities**

What You'll Do

* **Own programs end to end.** Own enablement programs end to end, from scoping and needs analysis through build, rollout, measurement, and iteration.
* **Translate strategy into programs.** Partner with GTM leaders to turn business priorities into clear program goals, owners, and timelines, and communicate trade-offs and progress to leadership.
* **Facilitate and coach.** Lead live trainings and workshops for audiences from new hires to senior leaders, and help front-line managers reinforce new behaviors in the field.
* **Drive ongoing development.** Deliver skills training (discovery, qualification, deal strategy), product launches, competitive updates, and certifications using repeatable frameworks new content can drop into.
* **Create content that sticks.** Build playbooks, battlecards, talk tracks, decks, role plays, and async modules with Product, Marketing, and subject matter experts.
* **Scale with technology and AI.** Lead adoption of enablement tools and apply AI to streamline content creation, reporting, and knowledge sharing.
* **Collaborate on role-based onboarding.** Work with Define "fully ramped" criteria by role and deliver learning paths that get new hires customer-ready quickly.
* **Measure impact.** Track ramp time, certification completion, content usage, and field KPIs using Salesforce and LMS data; report results and iterate.
* **Collaborate & Utilize the GTM knowledge base.** Keep messaging, collateral, and product content accurate, organized, and easy to find with the enablement team.

### **Required Qualifications**

What You Bring

* 5+ years in sales or revenue enablement, learning and development, or a closely related role, including 3+ years managing programs end to end in B2B SaaS.
* A track record of building and running programs, not just contributing to them, with measurable business results.
* Strong facilitation, communication, and coaching skills: you can distill a complex topic and make it land with any audience.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, building a coaching culture to enable reps to achieve growth goals.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate processes and improve enablement content and delivery.
* A data-driven approach, with experience building Salesforce and LMS reports that connect programs to field outcomes.
* A focus on adoption, not just delivery, using early wins and peer examples to bring the rest of the team along.
* Strong organization and follow-through across multiple concurrent programs; comfortable creating structure in ambiguity.
* Team player that is collaborative, a change agent, positive culture builder, and bridge builder across organizations and teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

Nice to Have

* Prior experience in a client-facing role such as sales, customer success, or sales engineering.
* Familiarity with B2B sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Command of Message, or Value Selling
* Knowledge of instructional design (ADDIE, Kirkpatrick), adult learning theory, or change management.
* Familiar with content development platforms such as Articulate 360 Suite; can create elearning content and experiences.
* Experience with enablement platforms (LMS/CMS) and tools such as Talent, Docebo, Asana, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Background in CLM, legal tech, or enabling reps who sell to legal, procurement, and finance buyers.
* Experience delivering sales and partner enablement or global programs across multiple regions.

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority.
