**Grant Program Manager, Tennessee**

*Remote*

**About Diana Health**

Diana Health is a network of modern women's health practices working in partnership with hospitals to reimagine the maternity and women's healthcare experience. We are restructuring the traditional approach to care to create an experience that is good for patients and good for providers. We do that by combining a tech-enabled, wellness-focused care program that women love with a clinical system that helps us drive continuous quality improvement and ensure work-life balance for our care team. We work with clients across all life stages to empower and support them to live happier, healthier, more fulfilling lives.

With strong collaborative care teams; passionate administrators and a significant investment in operational support, Diana Health employees are well-supported to bring their very best to the work they love. Come join us!

**Role Description**

You will be the day-to-day owner of a multi-year, state-administered grant that extends our care model across rural Tennessee through workforce development, patient engagement, and digital enablement. You will keep a large, cross-functional effort organized, on schedule, and audit-ready, and you will make it easy for clinical, operational, product, and finance teammates to do their best work. You will report to the VP of Finance and partner closely with Operations, Finance, Product, Analytics, and our clinical quality leaders.

#### **What You Will Do**

#### **Grant management and compliance**

* Own the master workplan, deliverables calendar, and reporting calendar across all 3 program pillars, and keep milestones on track
* Prepare and submit progress reports, reimbursement requests, and supporting documentation in partnership with Finance and Analytics
* Maintain audit-ready records and track allowable costs, effort allocations, and documentation in line with grant terms and 2 CFR Part 200 cost principles
* Serve as the day-to-day contact for the funder's program staff and manage budget modification requests and amendments
* Monitor spending against the approved budget and flag variances early

#### **Cross-functional coordination**

* Run the grant operating rhythm: weekly working sessions, monthly leadership updates, and quarterly reviews
* Facilitate communication across clinical, recruiting, training, marketing, product, engineering, and analytics teams
* Surface risks, dependencies, and decisions needed so leaders can act quickly

#### **Clinical quality partnership**

* Work with clinical quality leaders (VP of Clinical Operations, Regional Clinical Director, Chief Medical Officer and Chief Clinical Officer) to organize priorities across quality improvement projects, TIPQC participation, and quarterly clinical governance reviews
* Prepare agendas, capture decisions, and track action items through completion

#### **Training and onboarding coordination**

* Coordinate scheduling and logistics for provider and staff trainings, learning management system rollouts, and simulation drills with hospital partners
* Track completion data so training outputs are ready for grant reporting

#### **Measurement and reporting**

* Partner with Analytics to keep metric definitions, data collection, and quarterly reporting consistent with our logic model

#### **You Are**

* A detail-oriented organizer who stays calm while juggling many moving pieces
* A clear, warm communicator who builds trust with clinicians, operators, and funders
* Someone who follows through, documents decisions, and closes loops
* Energized by improving process and learning new tools
* Motivated by better outcomes for mothers and babies

#### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required
* 4+ years of experience in grants management, program management, or project management, ideally in healthcare
* Working knowledge of state or federal grant compliance, including cost allowability and reporting requirements
* Excellent writing skills and comfort with spreadsheets and project tools (Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence)
* Familiarity with HIPAA and patient privacy standards
* **Preferred:** women's health or maternal health experience, Medicaid/TennCare familiarity, PMP or CGMS certification

* Medical, dental & vision plans, with an HSA/FSA option
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off

* Having a growth mindset and striving for continuous learning and improvement
* Positive, can do / how can I help attitude
* Empathy for our team and our clients
* Taking ownership and driving to results
* Being scrappy and resourceful

As a Clinical QA Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring that all clinical resources are monitored to meet quality scores based on QA standards set by the organization. Overview:

LMI is seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to support Army Acquisition, Training, and Readiness (AT&R) and provide advanced technical support for the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS). ACWS is built on the Appian Platform. The Quality Assurance Specialist will plan, design, execute, and document software testing activities across the ACWS software development lifecycle.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will work closely with end users, functional SMEs, developers, Appian specialists, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and other technical teams to maintain ACWS availability, reliability, and user support quality.

* Develop formal test plans, test procedures, test reports, and other QA deliverables required by project and contract requirements.
* Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure adequate test coverage and clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and execute test cases for functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.
* Validate ACWS sprint user stories against acceptance criteria and support Agile testing throughout iterative delivery cycles.
* Log, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected-versus-actual results, screenshots, logs, and other supporting evidence.
* Maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, defects, and test results and ensure QA documentation is complete and audit-ready.
* Participate in defect triage activities and assist development teams with root cause analysis and defect resolution.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, quality metrics, defect trends, and recommendations to project leadership, stakeholders, and government customers.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of test strategies, procedures, tools, and QA processes.
* Collaborate with Appian developers, Java developers, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, functional SMEs, and stakeholders on requirements clarification and defect resolution.
* Support release testing, regression testing, implementation activities, and release readiness or sign-off processes.
* Participate in Scrum and other Agile ceremonies and provide QA input to sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and delivery planning.
* Support manual testing and the transition toward automated testing where practical and appropriate.

Qualifications:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 5+ years of professional software QA or testing experience.
* Experience with Jira test management or an equivalent test management tool.
* Experience working in Agile environments; Scrum or SAFe experience preferred.
* Experience developing formal test plans, test procedures, test reports, status reports, and other project documentation.
* Experience preparing professional contract deliverables and supporting documentation.
* Experience developing requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) and ensuring end-to-end test coverage of business and functional requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and government customers.
* Experience presenting testing results, risks, and recommendations to management, customers, and project stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* **Active Secret clearance required.**
* U.S. citizenship required.

DESIRED SKILLS

* Experience testing applications built on the Appian Platform, including Appian-based enterprise or contract writing applications.
* Experience testing government procurement and acquisition systems, including data exchanges, interfaces, and business processes involving contract writing, financial, or related federal enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with federal acquisition regulations and processes, including FAR and DFARS.
* DAWIA T&E Level 2 or higher, ISTQB Advanced, or equivalent testing certification.
* Familiarity with automated testing tools and frameworks and experience supporting the transition from manual to automated testing.
* Experience supporting Army, DoD, Federal Government, or other regulated software programs.
* Experience with Appian application testing, functional configuration, or Appian release validation.
* Experience with defect tracking and collaboration tools such as Jira, GitLab, or comparable platforms.

**Compliance Program Manager**

Department / Seat Name: Compliance  
Location: Remote (Role is open to only U.S.-based, U.S.-citizen-only)  
Salary: $105,000-$145,000  
Type: W2; Full-Time  
  
Role Summary  
The Compliance Program Manager owns the full lifecycle of compliance frameworks across the  
organization, from regulatory monitoring and internal program readiness through to the  
productization and launch of new service offerings. This role is the single accountable owner  
for knowing what is changing in the regulatory and framework landscape, determining what the  
organization must do about it internally, and converting qualifying frameworks into repeatable,  
sellable, deliverable service lines.  
  
This is a hybrid compliance and product role. Approximately half the seat is program  
management: tracking framework requirements, owning internal compliance obligations,  
maintaining authorization and accreditation readiness, and driving remediation to closure. The  
other half is product management: business case development, scoping, methodology design,  
pricing input, enablement, and launch coordination for new offerings.  
The role is not a people management position but carries cross-functional accountability  
across PMO, TAC, Sales, RFP, Marketing, and Finance.  
  
Role Purpose  

* To ensure the organization is never surprised by a compliance change, never out of

compliance with the frameworks and authorizations it operates under, and never late to  
market with a new offering that the changing landscape creates demand for.  
  
Core Responsibilities  
  

* Compliance Program Ownership

standard revisions, program updates, and authorization requirements across all  
frameworks the company operates under or delivers against

owner, control, artifact, and evidence location

program approvals, including document production, gap closure, and submission  
coordination  

* Coordinate internal audits, surveillance activities, and external assessment cycles,

including scheduling, evidence collection, corrective action tracking, and closure  
verification

margin profile, and go/no-go recommendation  

* Own the end-to-end productization of approved offerings, including scope definition,

deliverable set, methodology, work breakdown structure, level of effort model, and  
quality gates  

* Partner with Finance and Sales leadership to develop pricing, rate card entries, and

margin targets for new offerings

evidence requirements, and reporting formats

credentials, and technical readiness for each new offering

positioning, qualification criteria, and scoping guidance

jobs.title: Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Do you want to support Vermont communities and listing officials? Do you want to ensure equity in property taxes? There has never been a better time to bring your values and talents to the collaborative team at the Vermont Department of Taxes. We are seeking a senior assessor to work closely with listers and assessors and to help lead the Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program (CALAP). If you have a passion for working with municipalities and a talent for managing programs, we want to hear from you!

  

The Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program, created by Act 163 of 2022, supports municipalities in appraising high-value commercial properties to establish fair and defensible values. This is one of two positions that supports this program. The CALAP Manager is responsible for the day-to-day aspects of the program, including but not limited to working with appraisal vendors and municipalities to ensure projects happen timely. This position will work closely with the PVR Division Director, the Field Director, other PVR division supervisors, department legal staff including the CALAP attorney, and external partners including municipal officials and appraisal vendors. They will also work closely with 10-15 municipalities, serving as their district advisor.

  

**Key responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:**

* Providing training, education, and support to municipal officials to maintain the statewide grand list for the purpose of education funding.
* Conducting detailed analyses of municipal assessment practices through the annual Equalization Study.
* Evaluating and updating utility valuation methodologies.
* Reviewing applications to the program.
* Coordinating with vendors to ensure timely completion of projects.
* Reviewing appraisals for accuracy and completion.
* Participating in the appeals process as needed.
  

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* Experience in real estate appraisal or assessment, with some experience in reviewing appraisals especially for utility properties.
* Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience working with multiple vendors to ensure projects are completed timely.
* Some experience in reviewing appraisals especially for commercial properties.
* A desire to learn and grow and have experience fostering that desire in others.
* A proven record of prioritizing work, managing deadlines, and aligning expectations of internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of or willingness to learn about tax law and policies.
  

This is a full-time field-based position central to the southern portion or the northern portion of the State. Applicants will need to have reliable personal transportation to attend periodic meetings in the Montpelier main office and to conduct on-site visits with town officials generally in the Northern or Southern portions of the State. Click here to learn more about the technical and professional requirements of the CALAP Senior Assessor. For additional information about employee satisfaction and benefits, please see our website.

**About the Division of Property Valuation and Review**
-------------------------------------------------------

Property Valuation and Review (PVR) provides support to municipalities in developing and administrating property tax policies and related programs at the local level and has created an educational training and certification program that is available to municipal listers and assessors. PVR conducts annual ratio studies which estimate taxable property values and appraisals for school districts. It also administers the Use Value Appraisal Program (Current Use) which created almost $78 million in tax savings to landowners. PVR is currently implementing a new integrated property tax management system, and is planning modernization and digitization, making NOW the opportune time to join the team.

  

**Additional Information**
  
Compensation: The hourly salary rate for this position ranges from $33.53 to $52.55 and State of Vermont benefits are very competitive. The annualized salary for this potion ranges from approximately $69,742.40 to $109,304. The salary range reflects the minimum and maximum salary potential in the assigned pay grade, and the annualized salary figure is calculated based on 2080 hours of annual compensation and does not include authorized overtime or other compensation. It also doesn’t include any time taken off payroll. The starting salary for this position may be negotiable depending on experience and qualifications. This position is eligible for an office allowance and will be reimbursed for allowable business travel expenses.

  

**Background Checks:** This position will primarily support the Department of Taxes. Candidates must agree to be fingerprinted and pass a background check to be eligible for this position, which will involve access to sensitive federal tax information. Background checks are required by the Internal Revenue Service and are authorized under Vermont law. 3 V.S.A. § 241. In accordance with VDT Standard Operating Procedure 2018-01, Background Investigations, Vermont and national criminal record checks will be conducted on all candidates. Candidates will have the right to withdraw their application before fingerprinting or a background check is conducted.

  

We value diverse teams and are committed to creating a community of inclusion.

**Who May Apply**
-----------------

This position, **Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program Manager (Job Requisition #56091)**, is open to all State employees and external applicants.

  

If you would like more information about this position, please contact Christie.Wright@vermont.gov.

Resumes will not be accepted via e-mail. You must apply online to be considered.

  

Please note that multiple positions in the same work location may be filled from this job posting.

We can only consider people who live in the United States and can join live video calls during US business hours.**

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

Treaty Oak did not begin as a generic employment firm. It began with the demanding work of workplace investigations: neutral scoping, careful witness handling, documentation, evidence review, and findings that may later be scrutinized by an agency, court, board, executive team, or the court of public opinion.

That origin shaped the rest of the practice. Day-to-day employment advice, handbooks, onboarding, offboarding, training, executive coaching, and compliance work all benefit from the same discipline: understand how people and systems actually operate, identify risk early, and give employers clear footing before a problem hardens. Our litigation, coaching, entity, and estate planning work supports our entrepreneurial employers just the same.

**About You:**

This is a sales-oriented, client-facing role for someone who enjoys talking to people, building relationships, identifying opportunities, and turning prospective clients into retained clients. You will be one of the first points of contact for individuals seeking help with workplace issues, so strong communication skills, business savvy, empathy, professionalism, and the ability to build trust quickly are essential.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Patient Experience - SaaS, Clinical Healthcare
jobs.description:
##### **About Sycle**

Sycle is a market-leading global SaaS company with the mission of facilitating the delivery of better hearing to the world. Founded in 2001, we have grown to be the leading practice management solution for audiology (hearing care) providers, with more than 65% market share. The Sycle practice management solution frees up valuable time so our customers can grow their businesses through delivering high-quality patient care and exceptional services that delight their customers. Small hearing care practices and some of the largest retailers use our software in 13 countries worldwide.

The Sycle team is 120 strong. We are headquartered in Lone Tree, Colorado, with a large remote workforce across the US and Canada. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to help us build and deliver market-leading tools that make a difference for our customers. This role is open to candidates based in **Greater Denver only**.

##### **The Opportunity**

Today, hearing care practices lose valuable time and revenue to manual paperwork, phone tag, and disconnected point solutions. As Senior Product Manager for Patient Experience, you will lead the multi-year vision to replace these fragmented touchpoints with a unified, modern patient journey.

You will manage a portfolio spanning six interconnected product areas:

* **Intake & Onboarding:** Pre-arrival digital forms, tablet/kiosk check-in, OCR/speech data capture, and e-signatures.
* **Patient Communications:** Bi-directional SMS, email, and voice messaging.
* **Patient Portal:** Self-service scheduling, payments, clinical documents, and intake forms.
* **Reviews & Surveys:** Automated NPS surveys, feedback collection, and online reputation management.
* **Marketing Automation & Growth:** Patient segmentation, acquisition campaigns, and lead nurturing.
* **Recalls & Retention:** Automated recall cadences for annual hearing exams, device warranties, and follow-up care.

You will leverage cutting-edge agentic AI workflows to accelerate research, product requirements, and prototyping while partnering across multiple squads to ship high-impact software.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* **Vision & Portfolio Strategy:** Define the roadmap across all six areas, aligning trade-offs, build/buy/partner evaluations, and cross-squad delivery to business and customer outcomes.
* **Clinical Workflow Research:** Conduct on-site and remote clinic research with front-desk staff, audiologists, and patients (primarily older adults) to eliminate paper and reduce drop-off.
* **EHR Integration & Data Integrity:** Ensure patient data captured across intake, portal, and messaging syncs seamlessly into core EMR and scheduling systems without redundant staff entry.
* **Compliance & Accessibility by Design:** Maintain rigorous compliance with US and Canadian privacy, messaging, and accessibility frameworks (HIPAA, PIPEDA, TCPA, CASL, and WCAG 2.1 AA).
* **AI-Augmented Craft:** Embed AI tools into your daily workflow to rapidly model user journeys, draft BDD acceptance criteria, and prototype interfaces.

##### **Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 7+ years in software product management, with 3+ years in healthcare SaaS, EMR/EHR platforms, patient access, or digital front-door technology.
* **Portfolio Ownership:** Proven success leading multi-domain products across multiple engineering teams and delivering clear ROI (check-in speed, no-show reduction, recall rates).
* **Cross-Border Regulatory Fluency:** Hands-on understanding of healthcare privacy, patient messaging compliance, and electronic signature regulations in the US and Canada.
* **User-Centric Design:** Experience delivering accessible, hardware-agnostic web and mobile interfaces for senior demographics.
* **Agentic AI Proficiency:** Hands-on experience using modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, specifications, and rapid prototyping.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

##### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Background working with patient comms/engagement, scheduling, or reputation platforms (e.g., ReviewWave/Aloha, Updox, Weave, Podium, Twilio).
* Practical exposure to voice AI, clinical NLP, or OCR data extraction.
* Experience shipping products into both US and Canadian healthcare markets.
* Domain knowledge in audiology, hearing health, dental, optometry, or related ambulatory specialties

##### **Benefits**

* **Medical, Dental, and Vision:** Sycle pays employee-only premiums at 100% for base plans.
* **Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA):** Pre-tax options for Health ($3,400/yr) and Dependent Care ($7,500/yr).
* **Life & Disability:** Voluntary Life/AD&D; Short-Term (60% up to $2,000/week) and Long-Term (60% up to $7,500/month) Disability.
* **401(k) with Matching:** 100% match on the first 3% of salary deferrals, plus 50% match on the next 2%—with no vesting schedule.
* **Time Off:** Paid holidays (~14 days), 12 vacation days, 4 personal days, and 9 sick days.
* **Perks:** $50/month internet stipend and tuition reimbursement.

##### **How to Apply**

To apply, please submit your resume. If you’re going to submit a cover letter please focus on how your previous experience relates to this role and why you would be a good fit.

**Submission Requirement:** You must include a link to your LinkedIn profile both within your resume document and in the designated application field.

jobs.title: SMB Account Manager, Food & Beverage
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
  
  
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
  
  
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

#### **The Role**

Join the Square Account Management team and help our merchants grow their business! The Account Management team partners with SMB business owners to help them get the most from Square - offering tailored guidance to help merchants reach their goals.

As an Account Manager on our SMB Food and Beverage (F&B) team, you’ll be at the forefront of helping diverse, dynamic business owners thrive with Square. Reporting to our F&B team lead, your role is all about building meaningful partnerships with clients in the food space—understanding their unique needs, crafting innovative solutions, and championing them within Square.

In this role, you’ll become a creative problem-solver, finding ways to tailor our products to suit an array of complex business scenarios. As a trusted advisor, you’ll not only support clients day-to-day but also uncover new growth opportunities, expanding partnerships that fuel their success. This is your chance to be a pivotal force in your clients' journeys, advocating for them with decision-makers and turning their challenges into achievements.

#### **You Will**

* Own, retain, and grow a portfolio of SMB Food & Beverage merchants, helping them thrive through tailored adoption of Square tools.
* Drive expansion through product adoption, upselling, and value-based recommendations.
* Act as the voice of your merchants within Square, advocating for their needs with empathy and surfacing insights that shape our products.
* Balance proactive outreach, retention activities, and growth opportunities through strong organisation and time management.
* Work with our Sales, Support and Product teams to ensure customers have the best possible experience across all aspects of Square

#### **You Have**

* 3+ years experience in Sales, Account Management or related field
* Experience discovering and closing sales opportunities and building client relationships.
* Experience successfully managing a pipeline to achieve revenue targets
* Excellent organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
* Passion and knowledge about how new technologies can help better serve small and medium size businesses
* A track record of delivering measurable outcomes, driving adoption, and being perceived as a trusted advisor by clients.
* Experience within the Food and Beverage industry is preferred

jobs.description:
**Are you the person everyone comes to when they need answers? Do you love organizing people, making decisions, negotiating, and making sure everything runs smoothly? If so, we'd love to meet you!**

Select Advisors Institute is an established marketing, branding, and sales training agency based in Irvine, California. Since 2014, we've helped businesses across the country grow, improve their marketing, increase sales, and build stronger relationships with their customers.

We're expanding our team and looking for a few confident, outgoing, and resourceful Office Managers who enjoy taking charge, working with different personalities, and helping a business run successfully.

**Your Job Will Include:**

* Working with our vendors and outside partners, including communicating, negotiating, and coordinating services.
* Helping our associates get the information, resources, and answers they need to do their jobs.
* Participating in business decisions, researching options, and making recommendations.
* Assisting with hiring, including reviewing applications, interviewing candidates, and helping onboard new team members.
* Coordinating with different team members to make sure projects and daily activities run smoothly.
* Helping solve problems, answer questions, and make decisions throughout the day.
* Communicating with vendors, associates, and other business contacts through phone calls, Zoom, and email.
* Reviewing processes and suggesting creative ways to improve how we operate.
* Helping manage schedules, priorities, and deadlines.
* Taking ownership of projects and following through until they're completed.

**Who We're Looking For:**

* Someone who loves talking to people and has a confident, outgoing personality.
* A natural problem-solver who enjoys making decisions.
* Someone who is comfortable negotiating, asking questions, and getting answers.
* Excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to think on your feet.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Someone who enjoys working with different personalities and helping others succeed.
* A resourceful, independent thinker who enjoys coming up with ideas.
* Someone who takes ownership and follows through.

We welcome applicants from a variety of backgrounds, including office management, administration, hospitality, recruiting, sales, education, and business operations.

**Position Details:**

* 100% remote
* Part-time, approximately 20–30 hours per week
* Availability during Pacific Time business hours
* Opportunity to work with an established company and contribute to important business decisions

**If you're someone who loves being involved in everything, enjoys working with people, and takes pride in keeping a business running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you!**

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Key Account Manager (KAM) - East

**Region:** US East (ME, NY, NH, MA, CT, RI, NJ, DE, MD, DC, PA, WV, VA, KY, TN, NC, SC, GA, AL, MS, FL), Eastern Canada, portion of EMEA

**Location:** Must live in US, in territory

**Department:** Business Development

**Effective Date:** January 1, 2027

  

**Genea Overview:**

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of teamwork, transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace in 2021-2026, with a rating of 4.4 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. Our team members love our competitive benefits including 401k matching; PTO; 100% paid parental leave; 100% paid employee health, dental and vision benefits; remote work options; and an award-winning workplace culture.

  

**Job Overview:**

Genea is in an exciting phase of growth, and there’s never been a better time to join the team! We’re scaling rapidly, expanding our team, and creating brand-new roles—like this one—to help us innovate faster, serve our customers better, and take our success to the next level.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for engaging directly with large enterprise end users selling Genea Access Control solutions. This role is responsible for developing, expanding and maintaining ecosystem and integrator partner relationship, and will work directly with their respective global accounts teams. This individual is an experienced solutions salesperson who can think wholistically about modern SaaS applications, end customer’s adoption of cloud technologies, and various go to market strategies. The Genea KAM position requires travel and a strong aptitude for account management, technical sales, and working across a wide variety of enterprise sales environments. The Key Account Manager position reports directly to the Head of Sales.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage strategic channel partner relationships.
* Drive revenue through new customer acquisition.
* Target large, distributed, and often global end customers.
* Manage accounts through a complex buying process.
* Deliver expert quality sales presentations, end user demos of Genea access control, and visitor management solutions.
* Create strategic account plans that outline goals, strategies, and action steps to ensure alignment between the partner's objectives and the Genea organization.
* Conduct regular QBRs with accounts to discuss progress, outcomes, and any adjustments needed to the account plan.
* Monitor customer satisfaction, gather feedback, and share results to continuously improve the account experience and ensure future success.
* Use data and analytics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.
* Utilize and leverage data to construct, forecast, and manage sales activities to meet revenue targets and company goals.
* Manage a travel schedule comprised of weekly/monthly trips – meeting customers, prospects, and technology partners. Expected travel is 40%.
* Work within a team to develop sale proposals, quotations, and pricing strategies to win business.
* Stay current with the latest developments in the marketplace and competitor activities.
* Partner with Marketing to plan and execute in-market customer events.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 5-7 years of sales experience with a B2B SaaS company managing Key Accounts in Physical Security or related product types, in a channel environment
* Must reside in the US within the territory (ME, NY, NH, MA, CT, RI, NJ, DE, MD, DC, PA, WV, VA, KY, TN, NC, SC, GA, AL, MS, or FL).
* Bachelor's Degree with a concentration in Business, Communications, or related focus area is preferred.
* Proven track record in technical sales and key account management.
* Demonstrated ability to consistently generate revenue and exceed sales goals by managing processes for identifying, qualifying, and closing new business.
* Experience utilizing complex sales techniques within the enterprise sales process.
* Proven track record of revenue growth in a technology centric organization.
* Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).
* Aptitude for presentation writing and delivery.
* Ability to travel as needed within region (approximately 25-30% travel).

  

**Estimated Salary Range:** $150K base salary, up to $240K total compensation including sales commission and bonuses

The salary range listed is our best estimate based on the role's requirements and market conditions, but the final offer may be higher or lower depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications.

  

Genea participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires working in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please visit the E-Verify website.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional yet approachable tone.

* Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in consumer electronics, hearing protection, outdoor/sports, or similar product categories.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, review management platforms, or social listening software.
* Background in content creation or social media community management.
* Experience with loyalty programs or post-purchase email sequences.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Increased volume and average rating of product reviews.
* Faster, more consistent, and higher-quality customer responses.
* Measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and brand sentiment.
* Higher rates of repeat purchases and customer advocacy.

We offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment where individual contributions have a direct impact on the brand’s success. If you are passionate about turning great products into lasting customer relationships, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: RevOps Manager
jobs.description:
**Summary** We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next.

Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers.

Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency.

**What You'll Own**

HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored

The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses

Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal

AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced.

The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery.

**You're a Fit If**

You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust.

You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created.

You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ

Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex

You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling

You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing

**You're Not a Fit If**

Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix

You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue

You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation

Required Skills & Experience

* **3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems:** Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved.
* **CRM Architecture:** Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses.
* **Data Ownership:** You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number.
* **AI-Native Execution:** You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work.
* **Full-Funnel Accountability:** You measure your work through the full chain from signup trial qualified account paid renewal expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping.
* **Cross-Team Range:** Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow.

**Technical Proficiency**

HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API.

SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data.

Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, fai

The Clinical Cloud Operations Analyst applies working clinical imaging and technical knowledge to investigate and resolve moderately challenging, conventional application and workflow issues for assigned customers. This role evaluates diagnostic evidence and standard interactions among supported applications, PACS, databases, networks, and DICOM or HL7 interfaces using established methods.

Kentro is hiring for a **HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist** to support the **VA ESOM** **contract**. The HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist serves as a trusted advisor for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) field organizations as they transition to ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) as the enterprise system of record. The Specialist leads change management at the site level, training field staff on new processes, tools, and expectations while maintaining operational continuity.  
  
Kentro configured ServiceNow HAM for the VA, and this role is central to translating that configuration into consistent, policy-aligned practice in the field. The Specialist interprets VA asset management policy and directives, advises end users on compliant processes, and resolves complex and non-standard issues through root cause analysis and technical research, including issues involving device operating systems and how endpoint data is reflected in hardware asset records. **SUMMARY**

The Commission & Sales Operations Administrator is responsible for administering company sales commissions, supporting sales reporting and analytics, and providing Salesforce (SFDC) administration and Sales Operations support.

This role works closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Leadership to ensure accurate commission calculations, reliable sales reporting, strong CRM data quality, and effective Salesforce administration. The position requires strong Excel skills and the ability to combine and reconcile data from Salesforce and Odoo for booking, commission, and sales performance reporting. * Investigate and resolve booking and commission discrepancies.

* Prepare commission summaries for Finance and Leadership.

* Support commission audits and compensation reviews.

**Salesforce Administration & Sales Operations**

* Support Salesforce users, permissions, profiles, and access requests.

* Maintain Salesforce data quality, fields, picklists, page layouts, and other administrative configurations.

* Create and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards.

* Support testing and deployment of Salesforce enhancements.

* Assist with user training, documentation, and adoption.

* Monitor pipeline, forecast, bookings, quota attainment, and sales performance reporting.

* Support quota, territory, lead, opportunity, and booking administration.

* Assist with CPQ, quoting, and sales process improvements.

Overview

**The Problem**
---------------

Flock continues to expand across communities, creating a growing operational footprint and an increasing volume of employee lifecycle milestones. Supporting that momentum requires clear internal processes and reliable People data that teams can depend on every day. You'll take ownership of our core People workflows and HRIS data hygiene, turning recurring administrative requests into streamlined, predictable systems.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Support the end-to-end employee lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding, including transfers, promotions, and process documentation.
* Maintain data hygiene across Rippling and build onto our existing People data pipelines to support operational decisions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the People inbox and Console, managing employment verifications, work authorizations, and recurring employee inquiries.
* Partner cross-functionally with HR, Total Rewards, Recruiting, and IT to deliver a smooth onboarding experience for new hires.

------------------

----------------

Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub-based roles mean real in-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.

The impossible takes every kind of mind. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.

One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $78M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

* Technical troubleshooting instincts. You're comfortable reading error messages and sync logs, working through CSV imports and exports, and learning how a system's data model fits together. You can work out what's going on without a script.
* You're organized and keep a clean queue. No cases slip through the cracks, you set expectations with customers, and you over-communicate, especially on cases that sit with Engineering or a partner.
* You're self-starting and don't need to be told what to do next. If you see something that needs to be done, you thrive on the ownership to just do it. Ambiguity doesn't deflate you. Not everything has a process yet, and you're excited to help build it.
* Clear, warm writing. You can explain a sync failure to a stressed-out controller at month-end so it makes sense, and make them feel heard.
* A teacher's mindset. You like writing things down, building guides, and helping teammates get as good at this as you are.
* Comfort using AI tools and workflows beyond the surface level. You're interested in building more, even if you haven't had the chance to flex that muscle in previous roles, you will here!
* An empathetic, service-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day-to-day operations.

* Construction accounting experience, such as work-in-progress (WIP) schedules, job cost reports, certified payroll, union fringes, or prevailing wage.
* Experience implementing an ERP or payroll integration, including mapping setup, data migration, and go-live support.

jobs.description:
As we continue to look for new solutions to improve our trust, custody and unitization capabilities our business is focused on reaching our bold ambition while we help people around the world save and invest so they can confidently achieve their retirement goals.

  

This role represents an opportunity to be at the forefront of transformation, innovation, and service excellence for our U.S. Retirement business within the Global Wealth and Asset Management (GWAM) segment. The Business Analyst – Trust Custody and Unitization will help to shape a new trust operations ecosystem including complementary tenets of people, process and technology as we integrate with a third-party sub-custodian.

jobs.title: Dairy Solutions Specialist - Idaho
jobs.description:
### **Dairy Solutions Specialist**

**Remote, Idaho, United States | Full-Time | Exempt**

At Datamars, we help livestock producers make better decisions through industry-leading animal identification, activity monitoring, weighing, sorting, and data management solutions. We're looking for a results-driven Dairy Solutions Specialist to help accelerate growth within the U.S. dairy industry by partnering with producers to improve herd performance, labor efficiency, and profitability through technology-based solutions.

### **Why Join Datamars?**

* Opportunity to work with leading dairy producers across North America
* Industry-leading product portfolio and technology solutions
* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career growth opportunities within a global agricultural technology company

### **What You'll Do**

As a Dairy Solutions Specialist, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding customer relationships throughout the dairy industry. You will work directly with dairy owners, herd managers, veterinarians, nutritionists, consultants, and channel partners to identify opportunities and deliver customized solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and close new business opportunities within dairy operations, calf ranches, and integrated livestock enterprises.
* Execute territory growth strategies and achieve revenue objectives.
* Conduct on-farm assessments and consult with producers on operational improvements.
* Present solutions focused on animal identification, traceability, animal health, reproductive performance, labor efficiency, and data-driven management.
* Build relationships with key industry influencers, including veterinarians, consultants, nutritionists, distributors, and equipment dealers.
* Deliver ROI analyses and business cases that demonstrate customer value.
* Collaborate closely with Strategic Account Managers, Technical Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product Management teams.

### **What We're Looking For**

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Animal Science, Dairy Science, Agribusiness, Agricultural Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3-7+ years of experience in dairy, livestock, animal health, agricultural technology, or related sales environments.
* Strong understanding of dairy production systems and economics.
* Proven success in business development, territory growth, and consultative selling.
* Ability to manage complex sales opportunities and multiple stakeholders.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Dairy Science, Animal Science, Process Management, or related disciplines.
* Experience selling dairy technology, livestock equipment, animal health products, or herd management solutions.
* Established relationships within the dairy industry.
* Experience developing and presenting financial ROI analyses and value-based business cases.

### **Travel**

This is a field-based, remote position with approximately **50-75% travel** throughout the assigned territory, including customer visits, trade shows, industry events, and channel partner activities.

### **Compensation**

**Expected Salary Range: $90,000 - $190,000**

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant industry experience, technical expertise, territory responsibility, demonstrated sales performance, existing customer relationships, geographic location, and overall qualifications. Because we are open to candidates with a broad range of dairy industry backgrounds, compensation may vary significantly within the posted range.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

DATAMARS provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Temporary Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
The range for this role is $59,500 to $81,000
  
Actual base pay will be determined based on a successful candidate's work location, skills/abilities, experience, and education.
  
This is a temporary assignment scheduled to last approximately 60 days based on business needs.
  
Interested applicants must be located in an eligible state of employment with Christian Care Ministry: AL, AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, MO, NC, OH, OK, SC, SD, TN, TX, VA, WI, WV. Candidates who are within a 40 mile radius of the Melbourne, FL or Orlando, FL offices are encouraged to work onsite at least four days a week.
  
  
The Mission
  
At Christian Care Ministry, we strive to follow the early church example that we see in the book of Acts in the Bible, that modeled Christians helping one another and sharing in one another’s burdens. Through the use of Medi-Share®, a healthcare sharing ministry for Christians, we look to live out that early church example. To that end, our Mission Statement is as follows: Connecting people to a Christ-centered community wellness experience based on faith, prayer, and personal responsibility.
  
The Team
  
Everyone at Christian Care Ministry is in agreement with our Statement of Faith, which outlines our core beliefs. Although we aren’t perfect people, we are serving our perfect God and our Members to the best of our ability.
  
  
The Job
  
  
Summary
  
The Instructional Designer is a temporary role that will design and implement engaging, effective learning and performance support solutions. This role collaborates with subject matter experts and stakeholders to assess needs and develop learning content to meet those needs.
  
  
The Fellowship of the Believers
  
Based on James 5:13-16, every staff member must affirm the Ministry’s Statement of Faith and Conduct & Character Agreement and will be expected to participate in and/or lead prayer with internal and external customers when appropriate. (Because this will take place during the workday, these opportunities are included in the calculation of hours worked).
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Conduct needs assessments and job task analyses to identify learning and performance gaps
* Design and develop learning experiences for classroom, virtual, and eLearning delivery
* Create and maintain content such as facilitator guides, participant materials, job aids, and knowledge base articles
* Apply adult learning principles and instructional design best practices to all deliverables
* Conduct media analyses to ensure content is relevant, accurate, and achieves objectives
* Conduct formative and summative evaluation of course content
* Develop and manage learning paths and performance support tools in LMS and knowledge systems
* Use data analytics to evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements
* Collaborate with stakeholders to align learning solutions with business objectives
* Provide support and guidance to peers and end users on learning technologies and content
* Maintain and update content based on feedback, performance metrics, and organizational changes
* Ensure course development and maintenance train the appropriate skills and competencies stated in the learning experience objectives
* Support compliance training and reporting in coordination with HR and department leaders
* Manage instructional design project scope, requirements, goals and timeline
* Contribute to the exercise and expression of Christian Care Ministry’s Christian beliefs
* All other duties as assigned

Essential Skills & Abilities
  

* Proficiency in instructional systems design and adult learning theory
* Strong consultation, analytical, and communication skills
* Experience with LMS administration (e.g., Litmos, LinkedIn Learning) and eLearning tools (e.g., Articulate 360, Camtasia)
* Ability to manage multiple projects – conduct needs assessment and analysis, manage stakeholder expectations, prioritize efforts to meet timelines, and measure outcomes.
* Collaborate across teams – work with stakeholders and subject matter experts to deliver excellent work product and build relationships
* Familiarity with SCORM/xAPI standards and knowledge management systems
* Competence in Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Teams, and graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva)
* Ability to translate data into actionable insights and learning improvements
* Attention to detail – ensure accuracy and consistency to all instructional material

Core Competencies/Demonstrable Behaviors
  

* Collaborates – Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet objectives
* Communicates effectively – Delivers clear, audience-appropriate communications
* Member First – exhibits full commitment to serving members and/or clients by prioritizing their needs first in alignment with our program’s purpose. new_jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.  
  
  

### **Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
* Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
* Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
* Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
* Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
* Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
* Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
* Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
* Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
* Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
* Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
* Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience supporting B2B marketing efforts or high-volume audience segments at global scale
* Experience leading the transition of a workflow from manual execution to automated or agentic execution
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
* SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
* Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Overview

**About Liquid AI**

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across every kind of hardware, from data center accelerators to on-device chips, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.

**The Opportunity**

Our People team shapes how Liquid AI grows and how we look after our people, across the US and around the world.

We’re hiring a People Operations Manager to own our HR data and the operations that run on it, so every moment in someone’s time at Liquid AI is handled properly: their offer, their first day, a move to a new country, a visa, a pay review, their last day.

Behind every record is a person. Getting the details right is one of the most direct ways we look after our team, and you’ll make sure they’re right without needing to be chased.

You’ll report to our Head of People Operations and work closely with the engineers on our People team, testing and shaping the internal operating system they’re building. This is a hands-on operator role, not an HR business partner role.

This role will be based in our SF office, typically 4 days a week.

**What We’re Looking For**

We need someone who is:

* **Detail-oriented:** You notice when something doesn’t match, see how one change affects everything downstream, and fix it.
* **A team player:** You pitch in wherever the team needs you, and no task is too small.
* **Self-directed:** You get things done without much supervision, and you know when to escalate.
* **Someone who ships:** You work at pace, get through a high volume of work, and don’t let quality slip while you do it.
* **Someone who cares about people:** You see this work as part of how we look after our team, and you handle sensitive information with care.

**The Work**

* **Own our HR data:** keep HR, payroll and headcount records accurate and matching across systems, run regular checks, fix errors fast, and flag where they’re coming from
* **Handle onboarding and offboarding admin:** take care of the paperwork and system setup for every new starter and leaver, so their records are complete and correct from day one to their last
* **Manage employee changes:** process contractor conversions, moves between states or countries, contract amendments, salary changes, leaves and visa updates, so each one is touched once and done right in every system; for visas, work with our outside immigration counsel on documents and deadlines
* **Run benefits operations:** lead open enrollment, keep plan documents current and on hand, and work with our broker on renewals and compliance
* **Manage our people vendors:** be the day-to-day admin and escalation point for our HRIS, payroll, benefits and global EOR providers, and push open issues until they’re closed
* **Run comp analysis and offer letters:** benchmark roles against market data, model the full cost of offers and changes across countries, and prepare accurate offer letters consistent with approved terms
* **Help run cross-functional projects:** work with teams across the company on People projects, including our coworking weeks, which bring the team together several times a year
* **Test and shape our internal operating system:** be our main beta tester, running new features against real cases and working with the engineers until it’s right

**Experience & Capabilities**

What you’ll need:

* Experience in People Operations, HR operations or payroll, including time at an early-stage startup or on a small team where you covered a bit of everything
* Hands-on admin experience with a modern HRIS (Rippling, Workday, Deel or similar), owning the data and processing onboarding, offboarding and employee changes in it
* Experience with employees across multiple US states and countries
* Working knowledge of US benefits and compliance (open enrollment, ERISA, COBRA)
* Strong spreadsheet and analysis skills: comp benchmarks, cost models, headcount reporting, and the habit of checking your own numbers

Helpful, not required:

* A background in finance, accounting or payroll
* Experience with US immigration processes (H-1B, O-1, green cards) alongside outside counsel
* Experience with comp benchmarking tools such as Pave or Carta

**What Success Looks Like (Year One)**

* HR, payroll and headcount records match across every system, with regular checks that catch errors before anyone else does
* Every employee change, benefits cycle and vendor issue is closed and tracked in one place
* Our internal operating system has a tight feedback loop with the operations work you do every day

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation & Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.
* **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.
* **Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.
* **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

new_jobs.title: Product Manager, Trust & Safety
new_jobs.description:
**Join Us in Building the Future of Home Robotics**

At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 18 months building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

**What to Expect**

Sunday is putting robots into homes — around kids, pets, furniture, and families who haven't lived with a robot before. No regulatory body has defined what "safe" means for a home robot yet. We're defining it ourselves, and our brand depends on getting it right. You'll be our first product manager dedicated to trust and safety. You'll own the safety and privacy requirements for Memo end to end: what we test, what we promise users, and what we refuse to ship. You'll work across robot software, hardware, controls, ML, app, design, and operations to make safety a property of the whole system, not one team's checklist.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the safety and trust roadmap for Memo. Define what "safe enough to ship" means for each release, and hold the line on it.
* Build the system-level safety case. Map failure modes across navigation, hardware, controls, task design, firmware, and user communications, and make sure each has an owner, a test, and a mitigation.
* Work with engineering to define and track safety test coverage for every subsystem. Ensure firmware and software releases are validated against safety requirements before OTA.
* Own data privacy for the product: what Memo records in the home, who can see it (including teleoperators), how long it's kept, and how users understand and control it.
* Design how Memo behaves and communicates around kids, pets, and unexpected situations — stop conditions, warnings, recovery, and what the app tells users.
* Set standards where none exist. Draw on adjacent industries (consumer durables, home fitness equipment, new category products, appliances) to build a safety framework fit for a home robot — without importing process that doesn't apply.
* Run incident review. When something goes wrong in a home or the office, lead the investigation, root cause, and the change that follows.
* Partner with product operations to turn real-home observations into safety requirements.
* Define and track safety metrics: incidents per robot-hour, near-misses, test coverage by subsystem, time-to-mitigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years in product, safety, or quality roles on physical consumer products people touch and live with — think new category products, home fitness equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, or similar. You've shipped hardware into homes where the standards were thin and you had to set them.
* Not required: automotive, aerospace, or medical device background. While this is nice to have, we're looking for judgment in lightly regulated spaces, not fluency in pre-existing regulatory frameworks.
* Detail-oriented. You read the test report, not the summary. You notice the edge case nobody listed.
* Fast technical learner. You can pick up how a navigation stack, a controller, or a firmware release process works well enough to ask the right questions and spot gaps.
* Strong judgment and a deep sense of responsibility. You'll make calls that affect families, and you treat that seriously. You're comfortable being the person who says "not yet."

The Operations Support Manager is responsible for overseeing the organization's Training & Development, IT, and Supplies & Fulfillment functions to ensure employees have the training, technology, equipment, and operational resources necessary to perform their responsibilities effectively.

This role leads the development and coordination of training programs, oversees technology support and infrastructure, and manages the systems and processes used to procure, distribute, and track organizational supplies and equipment.

The Operations Support Manager partners with leadership and departments across the organization to improve employee readiness, maintain reliable technical resources, streamline purchasing and fulfillment processes, and establish consistent operational standards.

This position emphasizes effective resource management, team development, process automation, cost awareness, and continuous improvement. The Operations Support Manager is accountable for ensuring that assigned departments operate efficiently, meet established service expectations, and support the organization's broader strategic objectives.

* Oversee the Training & Development function, ensuring that training programs support employee readiness, role-specific competency, and organizational performance expectations.

* Establish processes for evaluating training effectiveness, gathering feedback, identifying learning gaps, and implementing improvements.

* Coordinate with field leadership and subject matter experts to maintain consistent training standards and reinforce effective operational practices.
